ph-skincare-oem.q_zh: 在菲律宾上市一款护肤产品(精华 / 面霜),代工厂要准备哪些资料、备案多久能拿到编号?
ph-skincare-oem.q_en: Launching a skincare product (serum or cream) in the Philippines: what does the OEM factory need to prepare, and how long does notification take?
ph-skincare-oem.lead_zh: 结论：菲律宾上市须由持有FDA营业许可证（LTO）的菲律宾本地进口商或经销商提交Pre-market Cosmetic Product Notification（预先备案），而非境外代工厂直接办理；代工厂需准备PIF（产品资讯档）与合规的英文或菲律宾文标签。 法规未公布固定审查周期，通常依FDA处理速度而定；备案号有效期为1至3年，须按期换发。
ph-skincare-oem.lead_en: Conclusion: Pre-market cosmetic product notification in the Philippines must be filed by a local LTO holder (importer/distributor) via the FDA eServices portal, not by the offshore OEM. The factory must supply the Product Information File (PIF) and ACD-compliant labels. There is no fixed statutory timeline; filing takes 1–3 years and must be renewed.

sections.h_zh: 代工厂必须提供的合规文件
sections.b_zh: 依据RA 9711与ACD附录，代工厂须移交完整PIF：配方INCI清单、毒理与安全评估记录、ISO 22716 GMP证书及质检报告（含36项IQC/IPQC/OQC测试数据），由菲律宾LTO持证方整合提交。
sections.b_en: Per RA 9711 & ACD, OEM must supply PIF: INCI list, safety assessment, ISO 22716 GMP certificate and QC data. The PH LTO holder files this via FDA eServices.

sections.h_zh: 法定责任主体与标签规范
sections.b_zh: 法定责任主体为持有FDA LTO的菲律宾公司（进口商或经销商）。标签须按ACD附录I以英文或菲律宾文标示：品名、完整INCI、产地、LTO持有人地址、批号及保质期；宣称须符合ACD规范。
sections.b_en: The LTO holder (PH importer/distributor) bears legal liability. Labels must be in EN/Tagalog per ACD App. I: name, INCI, origin, LTO address, batch, expiry. Claims follow ACD.

sections.b_zh: 法规未规定具体出号天数，以FDA最新官方处理进度为准；备案号有效期为1至3年，需按期续展。若资料不全或被抽查退回，将显著拉长实际等待时间，需预留缓冲。
sections.b_en: No fixed statutory timeline; dependent on FDA processing speed. Notification valid for 1–3 years and must be renewed.

faqs.q_zh: 中国已备案能不能直接当菲律宾备案用？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。中国境内备案在任何海外目标国均无法律效力，菲律宾须独立走FDA预先备案通道，不可复用他国证。
faqs.q_en: Can China's filing be used in PH?
faqs.a_en: No. CN NMPA filing has no legal status in PH. A separate FDA pre-market notification is mandatory.

faqs.q_zh: 产品含防腐剂或动物来源原料，会不会卡住？
faqs.a_zh: 需先对照ACD附录及2026-0001号公告排查限用成分（如BHT 24个月缓冲期）与来源声明；若含动物原料，清真或素食宣称即失效。
faqs.q_en: Will preservatives or animal origin block it?
faqs.a_en: Screen vs. ACD & FDA Circ. 2026-0001 (e.g., BHT grace). Animal-origin ingredients block Halal/vegan claims; supplier docs required.

ph-sun-care-oem.q_zh: 在菲律宾卖防晒产品,SPF / PA 检测报告要哪一种、备案怎么走?
ph-sun-care-oem.q_en: Selling sunscreen in the Philippines: which SPF / PA test report is accepted, and how is the product notified?
ph-sun-care-oem.lead_zh: 防晒产品在菲律宾按功能性化妆品管理，需在上市前通过FDA eServices门户提交Pre-market Cosmetic Product Notification。 测试报告需由认可实验室按ISO 24444(体外SPF)、ISO 24442(PFAC/PA)及ISO 24443(UVA防护临界波长)方法出具，标签标注须符合ACD Appendix I英文或菲律宾语要求。 以最新官方文本为准。
ph-sun-care-oem.lead_en: Sunscreen products in the Philippines are regulated as cosmeceuticals requiring Pre-market Cosmetic Product Notification via the FDA eServices portal before distribution. Test reports must be issued by an accredited laboratory using ISO 24444 (in vitro SPF), ISO 24442 (PFA/PA), and ISO 24443 (UVA critical wavelength). Label claims must follow ACD Appendix I in English or Filipino. Refer to the latest official texts.

sections.b_zh: 菲律宾FDA依据Republic Act No. 9711及东盟化妆品指令(ACD)管理。防晒属功能性化妆品，须由持有FDA运营许可证(LTO)的菲律宾本地公司提交上市前通报。
sections.b_en: Philippine FDA regulates sunscreens as functional cosmetics under RA No. 9711 and ASEAN Cosmetic Directive. A local LTO holder must file pre-market notification. Requirements subject to latest official texts.

sections.b_zh: SPF按ISO 24444体外法测试；UVA防护等级(PA/PFA)按ISO 24442；广谱判定需临界波长数据(ISO 24443)。报告须由具备资质的第三方实验室出具，测试用产品应与最终包装一致。
sections.b_en: SPF per ISO 24444 (in vitro); PA/PFA per ISO 24442; UVA critical wavelength per ISO 24443 for broad-spectrum claim. Reports from accredited third-party labs; test samples must match final packaged product.

sections.b_zh: 通过FDA eServices上传PIF(产品资料档案)完成通报，有效期1–3年可续。标签须用英文或菲律宾语标注产品名称与功能、全成分表、原产国、LTO持有人信息、批号及有效期等，宣称须符合ACD claims guidelines。
sections.b_en: Submit PIF via FDA eServices; notification valid 1–3 years, renewable. Labels in English/Filipino: product name, function, full INCI list, country of origin, LTO holder details, batch & expiry. Claims follow ACD guidelines.

faqs.q_zh: SPF50+如何标注？
faqs.a_zh: 测试结果≥50时可标SPF50+，须有ISO 24444测试报告支撑，不得无依据宣称。
faqs.q_en: How to label SPF50+?
faqs.a_en: Label SPF50+ only if test result ≥50 per ISO 24444. Unsupported claims risk regulatory action.

faqs.q_zh: 能否用中国或欧盟检测报告？
faqs.a_zh: 菲律宾FDA不自动认可境外检测报告，建议由认可实验室按ISO方法重新测试或提交等效性论证。
faqs.q_en: Are CN/EU test reports accepted?
faqs.a_en: Philippine FDA does not auto-accept foreign reports. Retest per ISO methods at an accredited lab or provide equivalence justification.

ph-hair-care-oem.q_zh: 在菲律宾做洗发水 / 护发素代工,无硫酸盐配方与标签要注意什么?
ph-hair-care-oem.q_en: Shampoo and conditioner OEM for the Philippines: what matters in a sulfate-free formula and on the label?
ph-hair-care-oem.lead_zh: 菲律宾洗护发代工需按 Republic Act No. 9711 及 ASEAN Cosmetic Directive（ACD）进行 Pre-market Cosmetic Product Notification，由持 FDA LTO 的菲律宾主体负责标签与合规，标签须用英文或菲律宾语（ACD Appendix I）。 无硫酸盐配方应以氨基酸或 APG 表活为核心，但需明确：无硫酸盐不等于低泡或无刺激，且 APG 体系偏碱、有气味，需 pH 与香氛设计同步处理。
ph-hair-care-oem.lead_en: For shampoo and conditioner OEM in the Philippines, compliance requires Pre-market Cosmetic Product Notification under Republic Act No. 9711 and the ASEAN Cosmetic Directive (ACD), filed by a Philippine entity holding an FDA License to Operate (LTO). Labels must be in English or Filipino per ACD Appendix I. A sulfate-free formula using amino-acid or APG surfactants is not inherently low-irritation; APG systems also carry alkaline pH and characteristic odor that must be managed in formulation.

sections.b_zh: 标签须包含产品名、功能、完整成分列表（INCI）、制造国、LTO 持有人名称与地址、净含量、批号、生产日期/有效期及注意事项。宣称须符合 ACD 宣称指南。通报通过 FDA eServices 提交，含 PIF 上传，有效期 1–3 年可续。以最新官方文本为准。
sections.b_en: Labels must state product name, function, full INCI ingredient list, country of manufacture, LTO holder name/address, net quantity, batch, and manufacture/expiry dates. Claims must follow ACD guidelines. Pre-market notification is filed via the FDA eServices portal with PIF upload, valid for 1–3 years and renewable. Reference the latest official text.

sections.h_zh: 无硫酸盐表活选型与体系控制
sections.b_zh: 氨基酸表活或 APG 为主时，pH 需落在弱酸至中性偏酸区间；APG 有偏碱倾向与特有气味，需同步调整 pH 与香氛。丰富绵密泡沫需引入两性或非离子表活辅助，不能靠堆高总活性物浓度解决，否则会推高刺激性与成本。
sections.h_en: Sulfate-Free Surfactant Selection and System Control
sections.b_en: When amino-acid or APG surfactants are primary, pH must sit in the mildly acidic to neutral range. APG has an alkaline tendency and a characteristic odor, requiring simultaneous pH and fragrance management. Rich foam must be supported with amphoteric or nonionic co-surfactants; simply increasing total active concentration raises irritation and cost without solving the foam problem.

sections.h_zh: 无皂基与冲洗类防腐挑战
sections.b_zh: 「无硫酸盐」常隐含「无皂基」诉求，但皂基与氨基酸体系是不同技术路线，膏体/清爽微涩肤感需脂肪酸酯类复配，工艺难度上升。冲洗类产品微生物风险高，即使走「无防腐剂」路线（如多元醇/有机酸替代），防腐挑战测试（ISO 11930 / USP <51>）仍不可省略。
sections.h_en: Soap-Free Claims and Rinse-Off Preservative Challenge
sections.b_en: “Sulfate-free” often implies “soap-free,” but soaps and amino-acid systems are distinct routes; a soap-free creamy texture with a slight dry-tight feel requires fatty-ester co-surfactants and higher process difficulty. Rinse-off products carry high microbial risk; even on a “preservative-free” route (polyol/organic-acid substitution), the preservative challenge test per ISO 11930 / USP <51> is mandatory.

faqs.q_zh: 无硫酸盐洗发水泡沫一定会比 SLES 少吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不一定。氨基酸/ APG 单一体系起泡弱于 SLES，但加入两性或非离子表活辅助后，泡沫量可接近传统体系，不必牺牲温和性。
faqs.q_en: Will a sulfate-free shampoo always foam less than SLES?
faqs.a_en: Not necessarily. Amino-acid or APG systems alone foam less than SLES, but adding amphoteric or nonionic co-surfactants can bring foam close to traditional levels without sacrificing mildness.

faqs.q_zh: 菲律宾标签必须用英文，还是可以双语？
faqs.a_zh: ACD 要求标签使用英文或菲律宾语（Tagalog），可以双语并行，但须完整呈现所有法定项目，以最新官方文本为准。
faqs.q_en: Must the Philippine label be in English only, or can it be bilingual?
faqs.a_en: The ACD requires labels in English or Filipino (Tagalog); bilingual is permitted, but all mandatory fields must appear completely. Refer to the latest official text.

vn-cleansing-oem.q_zh: 在越南做氨基酸洁面代工,表活体系怎么选、备案与标签要注意什么?
vn-cleansing-oem.q_en: Amino-acid cleanser OEM for Vietnam: how is the surfactant system chosen, and what must be right for notification and labeling?
vn-cleansing-oem.lead_zh: 越南氨基酸洁面代工首选椰油酰基谷氨酸钠/甜菜碱复配，并调整 pH 至 4. 5–5. 5 避免冬季结晶。 须依 Circular No. 06/2011/TT-BYT 及 Decree 43/2017 提交越南语成分与净含量标签，完成防腐挑战；由越南海关申报主体完成产品备案（以最新官方文本为准）。
vn-cleansing-oem.lead_en: Choose sodium cocoyl glutamate with a mild amphoteric copolymer for amino-acid cleanser OEM in Vietnam. Adjust pH to 4. 5–5. 5 to prevent winter crystallization. File and label according to Circular No. 06/2011/TT-BYT and Decree 43/2017, including Vietnamese INCI and net weight. Complete a preservative challenge test. The local importer or responsible entity must obtain the notification receipt (latest official texts apply).

sections.b_zh: 选椰油酰基谷氨酸钠配甜菜碱或 APG，pH 控制在 4.5–5.5，避免氨基酸盐游离析出；做 10℃ 循环，防低温结晶浑浊。
sections.b_en: Pair sodium cocoyl glutamate with betaine or APG. Keep pH between 4.5 and 5.5 to prevent amino-acid salt precipitation. Run a 10 °C cycle to avoid winter crystallization and haze.

sections.b_zh: 在越南，进口商或责任人须依 Circular No. 06/2011/TT-BYT 向卫生部提交上市前备案，取得 5 年回执后方可流通（以最新官方文本为准）。
sections.h_en: In Vietnam, a local importer or responsible entity must file a pre-market notification with the Ministry of Health under Circular No. 06/2011/TT-BYT, securing a 5-year receipt before distribution (latest texts apply).

sections.b_zh: 标签须符合 Decree 43/2017，含越南语 INCI、净含量、生产/有效期及批号；含防腐剂体系必须完成 ISO 11930 / USP <51> 防腐挑战测试，证明货架期微生物安全。
sections.b_en: Labels must comply with Decree 43/2017, including Vietnamese INCI, net weight, production/expiry dates, and batch numbers. A preservative challenge test (ISO 11930 / USP <51>) is mandatory to prove microbial shelf life.

faqs.q_zh: 氨基酸洁面能宣称“零刺激”吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。此类宣称违规，有投诉即担责；建议表述为“温和/低刺激”。
faqs.q_en: Can 'zero irritation' be claimed?
faqs.a_en: No. Such claims are non-compliant and carry liability; use 'mild / low-irritation' instead.

faqs.q_zh: 出样与起订交期多少？
faqs.q_en: What are sampling & lead times?
faqs.a_en: Samples in 5–14 days;

vn-sun-care-oem.q_zh: 在越南卖防晒产品,SPF / PA 检测报告要哪一种、备案怎么走?
vn-sun-care-oem.q_en: Selling sunscreen in Vietnam: which SPF / PA test report is accepted, and how is the product notified?
vn-sun-care-oem.lead_zh: 越南未将防晒按药品管理，走普通化妆品上市前备案（công bố sản phẩm）路径。 SPF/PA报告必须由目标市场认可的检测机构按指定人体或体外测试方法出具。 境外生产需由在越南注册的进口商或授权主体负责申报，取得5年有效备案号后方可上市，包装标签需符合越南语要求。
vn-sun-care-oem.lead_en: Sunscreen is managed as a standard cosmetic in Vietnam, requiring pre-market notification (công bố sản phẩm) rather than OTC drug registration. SPF/PA claims must be supported by test reports from accredited labs using specified methods. Foreign manufacturers must appoint a Vietnam-based entity to file the notification and obtain a 5-year receipt before market circulation, with Vietnamese labeling.

sections.b_zh: 境外防晒需向越南卫生部（DAV）递交上市前备案，境内产品向省级卫生厅递交，责任人必须是越南境内注册实体。
sections.b_en: Imports notify the Drug Administration of Vietnam (DAV); domestic products go to provincial health departments. The filer must be a Vietnam-established entity.

sections.b_zh: 数值必须由指定人体或体外测试方法支撑，不能照抄已上市产品数据。若配方变动，需重新送测并重新备案。
sections.b_en: Values must be backed by recognized in-vivo or in-vitro testing. Claims cannot be copied from existing products. Reformulations require re-testing.

sections.b_zh: 包装需加印越南语标签，包含成分、净含量、生产/有效期及责任人信息。法规细节以最新官方文本为准。
sections.b_en: Labels must be in Vietnamese, detailing ingredients, volume, and manufacturer info. Regulatory specifics rely on the latest official texts.

faqs.q_zh: 防晒喷雾能用吗？
faqs.a_zh: 需通过吸入暴露与运输限制评估，形态是否可行由法规与物流专家确定。
faqs.q_en: Are spray formats viable?
faqs.a_en: Sprays must pass inhalation exposure and transport limits. Viability is determined by regulatory and logistics experts.

faqs.q_zh: 备案有效期多久？
faqs.a_zh: 备案回执号有效期为5年，在有效期内可正常流通。
faqs.q_en: How long is the notification valid?
faqs.a_en: The notification receipt is valid for 5 years, allowing circulation within this period.

th-skincare-oem.q_zh: 在泰国上市一款护肤产品(精华 / 面霜),代工厂要准备哪些资料、备案多久能拿到编号?
th-skincare-oem.q_en: Launching a skincare product (serum or cream) in Thailand: what does the OEM factory need to prepare, and how long does notification take?
th-skincare-oem.lead_zh: 泰国化妆品上市前需完成预市备案。 法定责任人为泰国的制造商或进口商，其须持有本地注册经营场所。 核心资料包括：泰语合规标签、成分INCI及功能分类、功效与安全性声明、GMP符合性声明及生产商信息。 备案后系统生成回执编号，有效期三年。
th-skincare-oem.lead_en: Thailand requires pre-market notification for cosmetics. A Thai-registered manufacturer or importer serves as the responsible notifier and must maintain a local registered address. Key submissions include Thai-labeled documents, INCI ingredients, functional classification, efficacy and safety claims, and GMP compliance. Upon processing, the system issues a notification receipt valid for three years.

sections.b_zh: 备案主体必须是泰国境内注册并持有本地经营场所的制造商或进口商，该主体对标签与合规性承担法定责任。
sections.b_en: The notifier must be a Thai-registered manufacturer or importer holding a local registered address, acting as the statutory entity responsible for label accuracy and overall compliance.

sections.b_zh: 提交需包含泰语标签要素、完整INCI成分表、产品功能分类、功效与安全性声明、GMP符合性声明、制造商信息及进口商资质证明。
sections.b_en: Submissions require Thai-language label elements, complete INCI composition, functional classification, efficacy and safety claims, GMP compliance statement, manufacturer details, and importer qualification proofs.

sections.b_zh: 官方系统无公开的固定天数，审核周期视申报资料完整度而定。回执编号自提交完成之日起生成，有效期为3年。
sections.b_en: There is no publicly defined fixed duration; the review period depends on the completeness of the submitted materials. The notification receipt is issued upon successful processing, valid for three years.

faqs.q_zh: 备案编号是否允许修改包装成分？
faqs.a_zh: 不允许。编号与提交时的配方绑定，变更须重新提交。
faqs.q_en: Can ingredients be modified under one receipt?
faqs.a_en: No. The receipt is bound to the original formulation, and any modifications require a re-submission.

faqs.q_zh: 无本地注册的进口商能否备案？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。必须由泰国境内注册主体作为法定责任人完成备案。
faqs.q_en: Can an importer without Thai registration file?
faqs.a_en: No. Only a locally registered Thai entity can serve as the statutory notifier.

th-hair-care-oem.q_zh: 在泰国做洗发水 / 护发素代工,无硫酸盐配方与标签要注意什么?
th-hair-care-oem.q_en: Shampoo and conditioner OEM for Thailand: what matters in a sulfate-free formula and on the label?
th-hair-care-oem.lead_zh: 出口泰国洗发护发产品的核心依据是 Cosmetics Act B. E. 2558 (2015) 及其 2022 年修正案。 首先须确认配方中表活体系及辅料是否处于《东盟化妆品指令》禁限用清单之外；其次标签必须包含泰文法定信息，且进口后30天内须完成贴标；最后，若产品宣称“无硫酸盐”（sulfate-free），需确保实际未添加SLS/SLES，并符合冲洗类产品防腐合规。
th-hair-care-oem.lead_en: OEM sulfate-free hair care for Thailand is governed by the Cosmetics Act B. E. 2558 (2015) and its 2022 amendment. First, verify that surfactants and co-solvents are not on the ASEAN Cosmetic Directive prohibited or restricted lists. Second, a Thai-language label is legally required and must be affixed within 30 days of import. Third, any 'sulfate-free' claim must be substantiated by the absence of SLS or SLES, and preservative systems must pass ISO 11930 / USP <51> challenge tests.

sections.b_zh: 产品上市前须向泰国卫生部 Cosmetic Control Group 提交电子版上市前通报（Pre-market notification）。
sections.b_en: A pre-market notification must be filed electronically with the Thai FDA's Cosmetic Control Group before manufacture or import.

sections.b_zh: 泰文标签须在进口后30天内贴附，涵盖产品名、通报号、成分、进口商信息及净含量等。
sections.b_en: Thai-language labels must be affixed within 30 days of import, including product name, notification number, ingredients, importer details, and net content.

sections.b_zh: 无硫酸盐配方通常采用APG或氨基酸表活体系，须评估泡沫、冲洗性及防腐挑战，避免使用高浓度香精。
sections.b_en: Sulfate-free systems typically use APG or amino acid surfactants, requiring evaluation of foaming, rinse-out, and preservative challenges, avoiding high-concentration fragrance.

faqs.q_zh: 无硫酸盐是否完全不需要表面活性剂？
faqs.a_zh: 否，需替换为APG、氨基酸等无硫酸盐表活体系。
faqs.q_en: Does sulfate-free mean no surfactants at all?
faqs.a_en: No, it requires substituting with sulfate-free systems like APG or amino acids.

faqs.q_zh: 产品标签可以只用英文吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不可以，必须配有泰文，英文允许作为外文并排。
faqs.q_en: Can the label be in English only?
faqs.a_en: No, Thai is mandatory; foreign text is allowed alongside it.

th-cleansing-oem.q_zh: 在泰国做氨基酸洁面代工,表活体系怎么选、备案与标签要注意什么?
th-cleansing-oem.q_en: Amino-acid cleanser OEM for Thailand: how is the surfactant system chosen, and what must be right for notification and labeling?
th-cleansing-oem.lead_zh: 泰国市氨基酸洁面备案属 Cosmetics Act B. E. 2558 (2015) 及 2565 (2022) 修正案下 Pre-market notification 范畴，必须通过 Thai FDA 电子化系统提交。 表活体系首选氨基酸表活（如 1500 型）复配非离子或两性表活以平衡泡沫与温和度，避免单一高浓硫酸盐。 配方需控制弱酸至中性偏酸 pH，标签须含泰文产品名、INCI 成分及备案号，备案有效期三年，且需有泰国境内注册进口商作为责任人，法规依据以最新官方文本为准。
th-cleansing-oem.lead_en: Amino-acid cleansers in Thailand require a Pre-market notification filed electronically with Thai FDA, governed by the Cosmetics Act B. E. 2558 (2015) and its 2565 (2022) amendment. For surfactant systems, pairing amino-acid surfactants (e. g. , type 1500) with nonionic or amphoteric additives balances foaming power and mildness. System pH must remain weakly acidic to neutral. Labels require Thai text, full INCI lists, and a three-year valid notification number. A Thai-registered importer acts as the legal notifier, with all requirements subject to the latest official regulatory text.

sections.h_zh: 表活体系选型与 pH 控制
sections.b_zh: 氨基酸表活需辅以非离子/两性表活以解决起泡弱与假滑问题。体系 pH 须落弱酸至中性偏酸，偏碱将析出氨基酸游离酸并致浑浊。硬水市场须做硬水打样验证泡沫与皂垢，低温结晶风险靠调整多元醇比例而非盲目加盐解决，批次一致性优先使用聚合物增稠。
sections.b_en: Amino-acid surfactants need nonionic/amphoteric co-surfactants to balance poor foaming and slip. System pH must stay weakly acidic to neutral; alkaline pH causes free acid precipitation. Hard-water testing is mandatory to prevent soap scum. Winter crystallization is resolved by adjusting polyols rather than adding salt; polymer thickeners improve batch consistency.

sections.h_zh: 泰国备案路径与进口商责任
sections.b_zh: 上市前必须通过 Thai FDA 提交 Pre-market notification (จดแจ้ง)，备案号有效期 3 年。进口商或制造方作为责任人持证，需在泰国境内有注册地址。2026 年拟新增 10 项禁用物及 3 项限用物，需实时核对。
sections.b_en: Pre-market notification must be filed electronically with Thai FDA before import; the number is valid for 3 years. The Thai-registered importer is the legal notifier with a local address. Review the 2026 proposed list of 10 prohibited and 3 restricted substances to ensure real-time compliance.

sections.b_zh: 标签须在进口后 30 天内加上泰文，包含产品名、INCI 成分表、备案号、净含量及效期。允许外文与泰文并列，但不含比例信息。若使用无防腐剂或无硫酸盐宣称，需通过防腐挑战测试 (ISO 11930 / USP <51>) 并控制香精浓度，避免合规风险。
sections.b_en: Thai labels must be applied within 30 days of import, containing product name, INCI list, notification number, and net weight. Foreign text may coexist. For 'no-paraben/sulfate' claims, pass ISO 11930 / USP <51> challenge tests and strictly control fragrance levels to mitigate regulatory risks.

faqs.q_zh: 备案主体可以是境外工厂吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不可以。必须是由泰国注册进口商或制造商作为责任人持证。
faqs.q_en: Can a foreign factory file?
faqs.a_en: No. A Thai-registered importer or manufacturer must act as the notifier.

faqs.q_zh: 标签上能不能写“氨基酸浓度”？
faqs.a_zh: 不能，成分表只写 INCI 名称，不标注具体比例。
faqs.q_en: Can 'amino acid concentration' be shown?
faqs.a_en: No, the INCI list shows names only, not specific percentages.

us-sun-care-oem.q_zh: 防晒在美国按 OTC 药品管,代工厂要什么资质、SPF 怎么测、标签怎么写?
us-sun-care-oem.q_en: Sunscreen is regulated as an OTC drug in the United States: what must the OEM factory hold, how is SPF tested, and what goes on the label?
us-sun-care-oem.lead_zh: 防晒剂属于OTC处方/非处方药成分，产品在美国被归为药品而非化妆品。 工厂资质不等同于化妆品生产，需按FD&C Act满足药品生产GMP要求；SPF测试按OTC monograph指定的体外（UV-模拟）及人体防晒因数（Sun Protection Factor, SPF）方法，或采用等效方法并需按药品注册体系出具报告；标签须使用Drug Facts面板，包含NDC、活动成分、SPF 及防晒时间等，不适用普通化妆品21 CFR 701标签规则。 以最新官方文本为准。
us-sun-care-oem.lead_en: Sunscreens containing SPF actives are regulated as OTC drugs in the U. S. , not cosmetics. Facility GMP must meet pharmaceutical standards under the FD&C Act rather than cosmetics GMP alone. SPF is tested per OTC monograph methods (in vitro and in vivo human SPF protocols). Labels must use the mandatory 'Drug Facts' panel format with the NDC code, active ingredients, SPF claim, and usage directions, not standard cosmetics labeling.

sections.h_zh: 工厂需满足的资质与文件要求
sections.b_zh: 防晒产品在美国属药品，工厂的场地注册与产品列名须通过 FDA 的药品体系（Cosmetics Direct 对化妆品不适用），场地须按 21 CFR Part 211（cGMP）药品生产标准注册；标签的 Responsible Person 须为名称及美国地址印在包装上的制造商、包装商或分销商，且需指定一名美国代理人负责接收不良事件。
sections.b_en: As an OTC drug, the facility must register and list under the FDA drug system, not the Cosmetics Direct portal. Production must comply with 21 CFR Part 211 cGMP. The 'Responsible Person' on the label must be the manufacturer, packer, or distributor with a US address, and a US Agent is required for adverse event reporting.

sections.h_zh: SPF 测试与安全性证据
sections.b_zh: SPF 数值须依据 OTC monograph 指定的标准方法（通常包含人体 SPF 测试与体外 UVA 防护测量）进行验证，出具检测报告；配方中的防晒剂属 OTC 药效成分，若宣称含有特定活性成分或防晒指数，必须提交完整的 safety substantiation 记录（含成分纯度、重金属、微生物挑战及稳定性数据），以备 FDA 事后审查。
sections.b_en: SPF claims must be substantiated per OTC monograph methods, typically involving in vivo human SPF testing and in vitro UVA measurement. Formulators must prepare comprehensive safety substantiation records, including heavy metals, microbial challenge, and stability data, as required for post-market review.

sections.b_zh: 产品包装须采用 Drug Facts 版面，包含：活动成分（Active Ingredients，如 Avobenzone、Zinc Oxide 及其浓度）、非活动成分（Inactive Ingredients）、方向（Directions，如涂抹方法）、警告（Warnings，如避免儿童接触、可能过敏等）。NDC 编码必须清晰标示；绝对不可把设施注册印成批准或证书字样（注册≠批准、不发证书），因为化妆品成品没有上市前批准。
sections.b_en: Labels must feature the 'Drug Facts' panel listing Active Ingredients, Inactive Ingredients, Directions, and Warnings. The NDC code must be clearly visible. Statements that treat facility registration as approval or as a certificate are strictly prohibited (registration is not approval, and no certificate is issued).

faqs.q_zh: 若不想走药品体系，能否改做不带 SPF 宣称的日间产品？
faqs.a_zh: 可以，但须完全移除 SPF 数字宣称及任何具有防晒功效的活性成分，否则仍按 OTC 药品处理。
faqs.q_en: Can we make a day cream without SPF claims to avoid drug regulation?
faqs.a_en: Yes, but you must remove all SPF numbers and actives; otherwise, it remains an OTC drug.

faqs.q_zh: 加拿大市场是否同样按 OTC 药品处理防晒产品？
faqs.a_zh: 加拿大对防晒产品通常按天然健康产品（NPN）或处方/非处方药管理，需单独申请 DIN/NPN 编号，与美国体系独立。
faqs.q_en: Is sunscreen treated as a drug in Canada too?
faqs.a_en: Yes, it generally requires a DIN/NPN as a natural health product or drug, separate from the US system.

us-makeup-oem.q_zh: 在美国做唇釉 / 粉底代工,色料清单与重金属要求怎么过?
us-makeup-oem.q_en: Lip gloss and foundation OEM for the United States: how are colourant lists and heavy-metal limits met?
us-makeup-oem.lead_zh: 在美国市场，彩妆产品的色料与重金属合规需同时满足美国FDA法规及加州Prop 65标准。 所有合成色素必须使用已列入 FDA 化妆品色素清单的添加剂（清单不是对成品的批准；注册≠批准、不发证书）。 因矿物色料及植物粉体本身存在重金属本底，必须向供应商索取批次级重金属检测报告（特别是铅）；对于含滑石的产品，还需提供对应批次的石棉检测证明。 由于产品必然覆盖加州市场，需按“成分比对、限值判断、暴露量评估”原则排查Prop 65风险，以最新官方文本为准。
us-makeup-oem.lead_en: In the US market, color cosmetics must use color additives listed for cosmetic use (a listing is not product approval; registration is not approval, and no certificate is issued). Since mineral pigments and talc have inherent heavy-metal backgrounds, batch-level testing for elements like lead is mandatory. Additionally, talc requires batch-specific asbestos testing. Given that e-commerce invariably exposes products to California, the Prop 65 risk must be assessed by comparing ingredients, limit values, and exposure levels, in accordance with the latest official regulatory texts.

sections.b_zh: 唇釉与粉底中使用的合成色素必须使用已列入 FDA 化妆品色素允许清单的添加剂（清单不是对成品的批准；注册≠批准、不发证书）。若使用未批准色素，产品将面临FDA视为违法产品的风险，导致清关受阻或平台下架。
sections.b_en: All synthetic colorants used in lip gloss and foundation must be color additives listed for cosmetic use (a listing is not product approval; registration is not approval, and no certificate is issued). Unapproved pigments risk the product being deemed adulterated, leading to customs holds or platform removals.

sections.b_zh: 矿物色料、白泥或植物粉体默认存在重金属本底，须索取供应商出具的批次级重金属（尤其是铅）检测数据。若配方含滑石，必须取得对应批次的石棉检测报告，以满足FDA及私人执行方的严苛要求。
sections.b_en: Mineral pigments, clays, and botanics inherently contain heavy metals. Batch-level lead test data from suppliers is required. If talc is present, batch-specific asbestos testing must also be documented.

sections.b_zh: 面向美国市场的电商产品必然覆盖加州，需排查重金属是否超标。在确认暴露量是否超过安全港限值前，应按“需要添加警示”的保守原则预留标签版面，避免违规操作。
sections.b_en: E-commerce to the US inevitably exposes products to California. Prop 65 risk must be assessed by checking if exposure exceeds safe-harbor levels; conservative label space for a warning should be reserved.

faqs.q_zh: 帛卉能直接提供检测报告吗？
faqs.a_zh: 帛卉的质检体系（36项IQC/IPQC/OQC）包含基础测试，但批次级专项检测需由第三方机构出具，具体安排以书面报价为准。
faqs.q_en: Can BIOSPHERE provide test reports directly?
faqs.a_en: BIOSPHERE's 36-item QC covers basic tests, but batch-specific heavy metal and asbestos testing must be done by third-party labs; terms are subject to quote.

faqs.q_zh: 收到的Prop 65通知该怎么处理？
faqs.a_zh: 工厂不直接回复，买方需立即转交美国律师处理，帛卉仅配合提供配方与检测档案，以最新官方文本为准。
faqs.q_en: How to handle a Prop 65 notice?
faqs.a_en: The factory will not reply directly; the buyer must immediately forward it to US counsel, while BIOSPHERE only provides supporting records.

us-body-care-oem.q_zh: 在美国做身体乳 / 沐浴露代工,香精过敏原与标签怎么处理?
us-body-care-oem.q_en: Body lotion and body wash OEM for the United States: how are fragrance allergens and labeling handled?
us-body-care-oem.lead_zh: 在美国做身体护理，香精标签核心是成分表（按 FPLA 降序列出 Parfum 或 Fragrance）与过敏原披露：当前法规下致敏香料并非强制单列，FDA 的香精过敏原规则尚未最终落地（目标 2026 年 11 月），因此现阶段以 21 CFR 701 为基础。 身体乳（驻留类）与沐浴露（淋洗类）在香精残留与暴露量上存在差异，配方端须索取供应商 IFRA 合规声明与过敏原申报，避免后续披露与合规断层。
us-body-care-oem.lead_en: For U. S. body lotion and body wash OEM, fragrance labeling relies on the ingredient panel (FPLA descending order, listing 'Parfum' or 'Fragrance') because the FDA fragrance-allergen rule is not yet final (target Nov 2026). Since lotion (leave-on) and wash (rinse-off) have different exposure and residue profiles, formulators must secure IFRA compliance declarations and allergen declarations from suppliers to prevent disclosure and compliance gaps.

sections.b_zh: 依据 21 CFR 701 与 FPLA，按降序列出成分。含香精体系标注 Parfum/Fragrance。若使用天然精油且含特定致敏香料，需评估是否单列；当前法规未强制，以最新官方文本为准。
sections.b_en: Per 21 CFR 701 & FPLA, list ingredients in descending order. Label fragrance systems as 'Parfum' or 'Fragrance'. If natural essential oils contain specific allergens, assess individual listing; not currently mandated, subject to latest official text.

sections.b_zh: FDA 香精过敏原规则（NPRM）目标 2026 年 11 月落地，尚未生效。现阶段策略：向香精供应商索取 IFRA 合规声明与致敏香料清单，评估淋洗类（沐浴露）低残留与驻留类（身体乳）高暴露的过敏风险，保留文件备查。
sections.b_en: The FDA fragrance-allergen NPRM targets Nov 2026 and is not yet active. Current strategy: obtain IFRA compliance and allergen declarations from suppliers, assessing low-residue rinse-off (body wash) vs. high-exposure leave-on (lotion) risks, and retain records for audit.

sections.b_zh: 身体乳为乳化体，沐浴露多为氨基酸表活或皂基。加香时须控制香精在基质中的相容性与稳定性。避免通过过量加香掩盖异味。身体乳若含高浓度活性物（如 VC），需评估香精稳定性与变色风险。
sections.b_en: Lotion (emulsion) and wash (amino acid/synthetic soap) require checking fragrance compatibility and stability. Never mask off-odors with excessive fragrance. If lotion contains high active loads (e.g., VC), assess fragrance stability and color shift risks.

faqs.q_zh: 目前必须单列 26 种致敏香料吗？
faqs.a_zh: 目前法规未强制单列。FDA 过敏原规则（NPRM）预计 2026 年 11 月最终化，现阶段以成分表标注 Parfum 并留存合规文件为主。
faqs.q_en: Must the 26 allergens be listed now?
faqs.a_en: Not mandated yet. The FDA allergen rule (NPRM) targets Nov 2026. Current practice: label as 'Parfum' and retain compliance files.

faqs.q_zh: 沐浴露和身体乳香精用量要求不同吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不同。沐浴露属淋洗类，香精残留低；身体乳属驻留类，暴露时间长。配方端在评估 IFRA 限量与致敏风险时须区分两类暴露模型。
faqs.q_en: Do usage limits differ between wash and lotion?
faqs.a_en: Yes. Wash is rinse-off (low residue); lotion is leave-on (long exposure). IFRA limits and allergen risks require distinct exposure models.

ask-new-brand-launch-roadmap.q_zh: 我正准备启动一个新品牌，预算有限，想首发一款具有差异化卖点的面霜作为爆款，但在定位上很纠结是主打“纯净美妆”还是“高效抗老”，能帮我梳理一下选品策略和后续扩展3个SKU的路径吗？
ask-new-brand-launch-roadmap.q_en: I am launching a new brand with a limited budget and want to start with one differentiated cream as a hero product, but I'm torn between positioning it as 'clean beauty' or 'high-performance anti-aging.' Can you help me outline the product selection strategy and a roadmap for expanding to three additional SKUs?
ask-new-brand-launch-roadmap.lead_zh: 预算有限且目标是首发单款，不选面霜。 面霜可用周期长，首年复购数据难支撑现金流；纯净美妆与高效抗老均需强感知锚点，且合规路径未明前投包材开模风险极高。 建议先补全渠道、预算拆分及第一批用户访谈等基础约束信息，再重新定首发单品与后续扩展节奏。
ask-new-brand-launch-roadmap.lead_en: With a limited budget and a single launch focus, face cream is not the right hero product. It has a long use cycle, making first-year repeat revenue hard to prove. Both clean beauty and anti-aging claims need clear sensory anchors, and committing to packaging before regulatory confirmation is high-risk. The next step is to clarify budget splits, channel structure and initial user interviews before locking in the first SKU and expansion sequence.

sections.h_zh: 面霜作为首发主推存在复购模型缺陷
sections.b_zh: 面霜单支可用周期通常为半年以上，属于高价形象款而非高频引流款。若目标是用首发跑通复购现金流，高客单与低频次会让首年数据难看，且预算有限时无法支撑足够深度库存。
sections.h_en: Face cream has a weak repeat-purchase model
sections.b_en: A face cream jar typically lasts six months or longer, making it a high-price image product rather than a high-frequency driver. With a limited budget, it cannot support deep enough stock to prove repeat cash flow in year one.

sections.h_zh: “纯净美妆”与“高效抗老”卖点需可感知锚点
sections.b_zh: 这两个标签都不能只靠“添加某成分”支撑。纯净美妆的差异化需明确排除物清单与肤感差异；高效抗老需7天内可自查的现象。若卖点停留在成分名词，详情页第一屏站不住，必须回到配方端补感知锚点。
sections.h_en: Clean or anti-aging claims need perceivable anchors
sections.b_en: Neither clean beauty nor high-performance anti-aging can rely on ingredient names alone. Clean beauty needs a clear exclusion list and texture difference; anti-aging needs a self-checkable change within seven days. Without a sensory anchor, the claim will not hold on the first screen of the detail page.

sections.h_zh: 扩展3个SKU的节奏应在首发单款验证后启动
sections.b_zh: 预算有限时，首发只做单SKU单规格，不新增套装。3个SKU的扩展路径不应在首发前锁定，而应基于首发后的复购数据、渠道反馈和合规窗口，优先在同使用场景内换剂型或换时机，而非平摊资金做套系。
sections.h_en: Expanding to three SKUs should follow proof of the first one
sections.b_en: With a limited budget, the launch should be a single SKU in one format, with no sets. The path to three additional SKUs should not be locked in before the launch. It should be driven by repeat-purchase data, channel feedback and the regulatory window, favouring format or timing changes within the same use case.

faqs.q_zh: 预算有限时，面霜和洁面哪个更适合作为差异化首发？
faqs.a_zh: 洁面使用频次高、开盖后一两个月内用完，复购模型成立，适合作为首发主推；面霜只适合做形象款，首发押面霜会让首年复购数据难看。
faqs.q_en: When the budget is limited, which is a better differentiated first product, a cream or a cleanser?
faqs.a_en: A cleanser is used more often and finished within one to two months, making its repeat-purchase model stronger. A cream is only suitable as an image product; launching with a cream will make first-year repeat data look weak.

faqs.q_zh: 首发定位“高效抗老”时，哪些表述必须先有检测支持？
faqs.a_zh: 祛斑、医美级、替代处方产品等功效表述必须有检测支持，未经检测支持不得写入宣传语。具体功效宣称边界以最新官方文本为准。
faqs.q_en: For a “high-performance anti-aging” positioning, which claims must be backed by test results first?
faqs.a_en: Claims such as spot removal, medical-aesthetic grade or replacement of prescription products must be backed by testing and must not be used without it. The exact boundary of efficacy claims is governed by the latest official text.

ask-amino-acid-cleanser-formulation.q_zh: 客户要求复刻某款爆款氨基酸洁面，但反馈我们之前的版本泡沫不够绵密且洗后紧绷，同时担心夏季高温下泵头挤出时会出现结晶析出，应该调整哪些表活体系和增稠方案来解决这些问题？
ask-amino-acid-cleanser-formulation.q_en: The client wants to replicate a bestselling amino acid cleanser, but our previous prototype lacked dense foam and felt tight after washing. We are also concerned about crystallization at high summer temperatures when dispensing. Which surfactant system and thickening adjustments should we make to resolve these issues?
ask-amino-acid-cleanser-formulation.lead_zh: 无法复刻竞品配方，仅能对标性能。 解决泡沫与紧绷需引入非离子/两性表活辅助起泡，下调活性物总浓度并调整肤感预期。 夏季结晶是反常现象，结晶通常由低温触发，建议先排查原料纯度与储存条件，增稠方案优先采用聚合物复配以稳定批次，具体比例需重新打样验证。
ask-amino-acid-cleanser-formulation.lead_en: Direct replication is impossible; performance benchmarking is required. To improve foam and reduce tightness, introduce nonionic or amphoteric surfactants as co-surfactants and adjust total active concentrations. Summer crystallization is atypical, as crystal formation is usually temperature-induced by cold. Investigate raw material purity first. For viscosity stability, prefer polymer co-thickening systems over salt-based ones to ensure batch consistency. Specific ratios require re-formulation and testing.

sections.b_zh: 单一氨基酸体系起泡弱。建议复配两性表活（如甜菜碱）或非离子表活以提升泡沫绵密度，同时下调总活性物浓度以缓解紧绷感。不通过提高浓度解决泡沫问题。
sections.b_en: Single amino acid surfactants foam poorly. Recommend blending with amphoteric (e.g., betaine) or nonionic surfactants to enhance foam density, while lowering total active concentration to relieve tightness. Do not increase concentration to solve foam issues.

sections.b_zh: 夏季高温通常导致浑浊而非结晶，结晶多发生于低温。建议排查原料纯度与包装密封性，必要时进行低温循环测试确认。若确认为高温问题，需调整多元醇比例以维持溶解度。
sections.b_en: High summer heat causes turbidity, not crystallization. Crystallization is usually low-temperature induced. Check raw material purity and packaging integrity. Adjust polyol ratios to maintain solubility if needed.

sections.b_zh: 避免依赖氯化钠增稠，其曲线峰值会导致批次波动。建议改用聚合物或复配增稠体系，以获得更稳定的批次一致性和夏季储存稳定性。
sections.b_en: Avoid relying on NaCl thickening due to curve peaks and batch fluctuations. Use polymer or co-thickening systems for better batch consistency and summer storage stability.

faqs.q_zh: 为什么不能直接抄竞品成分表？
faqs.a_zh: 成分表不含原料牌号与复配母液信息，逐条复刻无法保证肤感一致。
faqs.q_en: Why not copy the competitor's ingredient list?
faqs.a_en: Ingredient lists lack raw material grades and premix info; direct copying cannot guarantee identical sensory performance.

faqs.q_zh: 夏季结晶是否一定由配方导致？
faqs.a_zh: 不一定，需排除原料杂质或运输异常，先做低温循环测试再定论。
faqs.q_en: Is summer crystallization always formulation-caused?
faqs.a_en: Not necessarily; rule out raw material impurities or transport anomalies. Perform low-temperature cycling tests before drawing conclusions.

ask-sustainable-claims-audit.q_zh: 我们计划全线使用再生塑料包装并宣称“零残忍”，但担心被欧美买手判定为“洗绿”，请问除了拿到 Leaping Bunny 认证外，在包装溯源和可回收性声明上还需要做哪些额外的验证测试？
ask-sustainable-claims-audit.q_en: We plan to use recycled plastic packaging across the line and claim 'cruelty-free,' but we fear European buyers will label this as 'greenwashing.' Beyond obtaining Leaping Bunny certification, what additional validation tests are required for packaging traceability and recyclability claims?
ask-sustainable-claims-audit.lead_zh: 不能仅凭 Leaping Bunny 认证支撑包装宣称。 PCR 比例必须限定到具体部件并提供链条证书与批次追溯，可降解宣称需指明测试标准与介质。 若目标市场含欧盟，禁止使用笼统环保词，且不能以碳抵消支撑零碳表述。 所有绿色宣称若无第三方文件背书，将构成虚标风险。
ask-sustainable-claims-audit.lead_en: Leaping Bunny alone does not validate packaging claims. PCR ratios must be limited to specific components with chain-of-custody certificates and batch traceability. Biodegradability claims require specified test standards and media. If targeting the EU, vague eco-terms are prohibited, and carbon offsets cannot support zero-carbon wording. Unsubstantiated claims constitute fraud risk.

sections.b_zh: PCR 宣称必须锁定至瓶身、泵头或外盒等具体部件，分母口径需明确。需获取供应商链条证书及批次追溯记录，证明再生料真实比例，避免分母模糊导致数字虚高。
sections.b_en: PCR claims must target specific components like bottles or pumps, with clear denominator definitions. Supplier chain-of-custody certificates and batch traceability are mandatory to verify actual recycled material ratios and prevent inflated numbers.

sections.b_zh: 可回收宣称需说明部件在销售地的实际回收可及性。若宣称可降解，必须指定测试标准（如 OECD 301 系列）与环境介质。多材质复合件在多数体系不可回收，此类表述需整句删除。
sections.b_en: Recyclability claims must address component availability in the sales market's recycling systems. Biodegradability requires specific standards (e.g., OECD 301) and media. Multi-material components are generally non-recyclable; such claims must be removed.

sections.b_zh: 若涉欧盟市场，禁止使用「环保」等笼统通用词。碳中和表述不得由碳抵消支撑。自设环保标签未经第三方认证不得使用。具体生效时点与细则以最新官方文本为准，避免写死日期。
sections.b_en: For EU markets, vague terms like 'eco-friendly' are prohibited. Zero-carbon claims cannot rely on carbon offsets. Self-declared eco-labels are invalid without third-party certification. Specific effective dates follow the latest official texts.

faqs.q_zh: PCR 证书可以覆盖整个工厂吗？
faqs.a_zh: 否，证书需覆盖至具体 SKU 与部件。
faqs.q_en: Does PCR certification cover the whole plant?
faqs.a_en: No, certificates must cover specific SKUs and components.

faqs.q_zh: 能用碳抵消写零碳吗？
faqs.a_zh: 若目标市场含欧盟，禁止用抵消支撑零碳表述。
faqs.q_en: Can offsets support zero-carbon claims?
faqs.a_en: No, carbon offsets cannot support zero-carbon claims in the EU.

sources.t: CosIng 化妆品成分数据库

ask-emulsion-texture-stability.q_zh: 对标欧莱雅某款轻薄乳液，客户反馈当前样品的“肤感太假滑且高温三个月后分层”，工厂能否通过调整液晶乳化结构来解决质构粗糙问题，并通过离心测试验证其在40℃下的稳定性？
ask-emulsion-texture-stability.q_en: Benchmarking against a specific L'Oréal light lotion, the client feedback says the current sample feels 'fakely slick and separated after 3 months at high temperature.' Can the factory adjust the lyotropic liquid crystal emulsification structure to fix the coarse texture and verify stability at 40°C via centrifugation testing?
ask-emulsion-texture-stability.lead_zh: 仅靠调整液晶乳化结构无法解决“假滑”与分层，因该现象指向界面张力异常与油膜过厚，需先做空白与加香对照，并引入屈服值流变改造。 稳定性验证不能只依赖离心测试，依据 40°C 加速 3 个月及冻融标准，必须配合 ISO 11930 防腐挑战，才能排除批次失稳风险。
ask-emulsion-texture-stability.lead_en: Adjusting lyotropic structure alone fails to fix 'fakely slick' feel and high-temp separation, which suggest abnormal interfacial tension and excessive oil film. First, conduct blank vs. perfumed controls and yield value rheology modification. Stability verification must not rely on centrifugation alone; per 40°C accelerated protocols and freeze-thaw standards, ISO 11930 challenge tests are required to rule out batch instability risks.

sections.h_zh: 假滑归因：从流变改造入手
sections.b_zh: “太假滑”常因油相偏高或香精增溶不当。需先做“空白 vs 加香”对照，排除乳化体系失效。再引入气相二氧化硅或黄原胶建立屈服值，而非盲目增加乳化剂，避免加重假滑感。
sections.b_en: 'Fakely slick' often stems from high oil phase or improper perfume solubilization. Run blank vs. perfumed controls first to rule out emulsion failure. Then build yield value using fumed silica or xanthan gum, instead of adding surfactants which worsen slickness.

sections.h_zh: 高温分层：液晶结构需重组
sections.b_zh: 高温分层是稳定性失败。液晶乳化对温差敏感，需结合内水相电解质抑制液滴熟化。不能只看离心结果，须确认油相极性匹配，否则高温下结构会坍塌，导致样品返工。
sections.b_en: High-temperature separation is a stability failure. Lyotropic structures are temperature-sensitive; add internal electrolytes to inhibit droplet maturation. Do not rely solely on centrifugation; verify oil phase polarity matching to prevent structure collapse.

sections.h_zh: 稳定性验证：全流程包材测试
sections.b_zh: 验证需涵盖 40°C 三个月及冻融循环，并在最终包材中执行。若离心后见清晰油层，直接退回重做。放行依据稳定性专家结论，不以单一离心数据为准，确保货架期符合法规。
sections.b_en: Validation requires 40°C 3-month testing and freeze-thaw cycles in final packaging. If clear oil layers appear post-centrifuge, reject the batch. Release relies on stability expert conclusions, not single centrifuge data, ensuring shelf-life compliance.

faqs.q_zh: 离心测试能否作为唯一放行依据？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。离心仅筛选初筛，必须配合 40°C 加速与冻融循环，最终在包材中验证。
faqs.q_en: Can centrifugation be the sole release criterion?
faqs.a_en: No. Centrifugation is only a screen. It must be combined with 40°C accelerated testing and freeze-thaw cycles in final packaging.

faqs.q_zh: 液晶乳化比传统乳化更稳定吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不一定。液晶结构对温差和灌装剪切敏感，需更保守的包材与储运条件，风险在合同中明确。
faqs.q_en: Is lyotropic emulsification more stable than traditional?
faqs.a_en: Not necessarily. Lyotropic structures are sensitive to temperature and shear. Conservative packaging and shipping conditions are required; risks must be defined in the contract.

ask-raw-material-substitution.q_zh: 核心原料供应商因产能不足导致批间色差和气味不稳定，工厂是否有备选的同源INCI替代原料，且能提供完整的COA和重金属检测报告以通过进口国的安全审查？
ask-raw-material-substitution.q_en: The core raw material supplier is experiencing inter-batch color variance and odor instability due to capacity issues. Does the factory have alternative sources for the same INCI with complete COAs and heavy metal test reports to pass the import country's safety review?
ask-raw-material-substitution.lead_zh: 同 INCI 不能默认互通，工厂可提供同源替代候选，但必须附原厂 COA 实测数值并建立分装批号追溯链，重金属与安全声明需完整；未通过稳定性与微生物挑战前不可量产，进口国安全审查须按当地最新法规执行。
ask-raw-material-substitution.lead_en: The same INCI does not automatically mean interchangeability. The factory can provide alternative candidates, but each must carry an original manufacturer's COA with measured values and a traceable lot-number chain. Heavy metal and safety declarations must be complete. No mass production before stability and challenge tests; import-country review follows the latest regulations.

sections.b_zh: 替代料必须提供带实测数值的原厂 COA，若经贸易商分装须建立分装批号与原厂批号的对应关系，链条断裂则不得入库。
sections.b_en: Alternative materials require original manufacturer COAs with measured values. If repackaged, a lot-number link between repack and original batches must be established; broken chains are not accepted.

sections.b_zh: INCI 一致不代表载体、活性物含量、粒径、防腐体系一致，替代前需重做稳定性（高温 4 周起）与微生物挑战。
sections.b_en: Same INCI does not guarantee identical carrier, active content, particle size, or preservative. Stability (4-week high-temp) and microbial challenge must be re-run.

sections.b_zh: 重金属检测、过敏原声明、非动物源及 BSE 声明必须随货提供，按目标市场最新法规执行，缺项则无法通过清关审查。
sections.b_en: Heavy metal, allergen, non-animal, and BSE declarations must accompany the shipment per target-market regulations. Missing items block customs clearance.

faqs.q_zh: 临时救急替换允许直接量产吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不允许，须限定批次、全程标识、加严留样，不得默认为长期方案。
faqs.q_en: Is a temporary emergency swap allowed for mass production?
faqs.a_en: No. not a default long-term plan.

faqs.q_zh: 供应商拒绝提供重金属声明怎么办？
faqs.a_zh: 无论价格多低，不进入合格供应商清单，避免扣关风险。
faqs.q_en: What if a supplier refuses to provide heavy-metal declarations?
faqs.a_en: Regardless of price, exclude from the qualified list to avoid customs hold risk.

ask-oem-mold-ownership.q_zh: 代工合同中对模具所有权归属有争议，客户担心工厂会将定制模具用于其他品牌，工厂能否在合同中明确模具的独占使用权及保密违约责任条款？
ask-oem-mold-ownership.q_en: There is a dispute in the OEM contract regarding mold ownership; the client fears the factory will use the custom molds for other brands. Can the factory clarify the exclusive usage rights of the molds and confidentiality breach liability clauses in the contract?
ask-oem-mold-ownership.lead_zh: 模具所有权与使用权在代工合同中应作为独立条款分别约定。 若客户支付开模费，合同应明确约定模具的所有权归属；若客户享有所有权，需进一步明确合作终止后模具的退还、销毁或保管期限等处置方式。 同时，若工厂在合同中承诺“不得将模具用于其他品牌”（即独占使用权），必须明确该独占的品类范围、地域范围与时间期限，并约定最低采购量及未达标时的自动失效机制。 关于保密违约责任条款，合同应写明违约金的计算方法或责任上限，但不应无上限地约定连带赔偿责任。 相关条款须以最新官方文本及执业律师意见为准。
ask-oem-mold-ownership.lead_en: Mold ownership and usage rights must be drafted as separate clauses in an OEM contract. If the client funds the mold creation, the contract must explicitly stipulate ownership attribution; upon termination, it must detail the disposition of the molds, such as return, destruction, or storage periods. If the factory agrees to 'exclusive usage rights', the contract must define the scope of products, regions, and time limits, along with minimum purchase quantities and auto-expiration conditions if targets are not met. Regarding confidentiality breach liability, penalties should have a calculable basis and an overall cap to avoid unbounded exposure. Always refer to the latest official legal texts and licensed attorney advice for these clauses.

sections.h_zh: 所有权与使用权分离条款设计
sections.b_zh: 合同约定开模费归属不等于约定所有权归属。工厂需单独写明若客户支付开模费，模具所有权归客户所有；客户享独占使用权时，必须界定品类、地域与时间范围，并设置最低采购量及未达标自动降级或失效机制。
sections.h_en: Separation of Ownership and Usage Rights Clauses
sections.b_en: Stating who pays the mold fee is not the same as stating who owns it. If the client pays, the contract must explicitly assign ownership to them. Exclusive usage rights must be limited to specific product lines, regions, and time frames, with minimum purchase quantities and auto-expiration clauses.

sections.h_zh: 合作终止后的处置与保管机制
sections.b_zh: 针对工厂保管客户模具的实际情况，合同应明确合作终止后工厂的保管期限（如退还或销毁的节点）、移交方式及逾期不取的处理方式。不得默认工厂有权长期保管或自行销毁，避免日后产生保管费与报废责任的争议。
sections.b_en: Factoring in the reality of factory custody, the contract must specify the storage period for client-owned molds upon termination, transfer methods, and procedures for unclaimed items. It cannot assume the factory has the right to retain or destroy them indefinitely without liability.

sections.h_zh: 保密条款与责任上限约束
sections.b_zh: 约定工厂不得将定制模具及配方用于其他品牌时，属于保密与知识产权保护范畴。违约责任应明确违约金的计算标准或责任上限，排除不可预见的间接损失，防止一笔小订单因无上限的保密违约赔偿而产生不可控的财务敞口。
sections.b_en: Committing not to use custom molds or formulations for other brands falls under confidentiality and IP protection. Breach liability must define calculation standards for penalties or an overall liability cap, excluding unforeseen indirect damages to prevent uncontrolled financial exposure.

faqs.q_zh: 工厂能否在合同中要求即使客户未付款也保留模具？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。若所有权已约定归客户，工厂仅能主张留置权并要求支付保管费，但留置权的行使条件与范围受《民法典》约束。
faqs.q_en: Can the factory demand to keep the molds if the client hasn't paid?
faqs.a_en: No. If ownership is explicitly assigned to the client, the factory can only assert a lien and claim storage fees, subject to statutory limits.

faqs.q_zh: 模具报废后，工厂需向客户证明确实销毁了吗？
faqs.a_zh: 需要。合同约定由第三方出具报废证明或提供销毁视频留存，可消除客户对工厂将模具转售或复用为其他品牌提供产品的顾虑。
faqs.q_en: Must the factory prove the destruction of the molds to the client after scrapping?
faqs.a_en: Yes. The contract should require a third-party destruction certificate or retain video evidence to eliminate client concerns about the molds being sold or reused.

ask-trade-secret-protection.q_zh: 我们有一款独家配方的精华液，担心研发人员离职导致配方泄露，工厂能否签署严格的NDA，并说明其生产环节的配方保密管理流程及侵权赔偿机制？
ask-trade-secret-protection.q_en: We have a proprietary serum formula and fear leakage due to R&D staff turnover. Can the factory sign a strict NDA and explain its confidential formula management process in production and the compensation mechanism for infringement?
ask-trade-secret-protection.lead_zh: 工厂具备签署保密协议的条件，但防漏体系必须落实到证据链的颗粒度。 单靠一纸NDA无法证明已采取有效的技术保密措施，若未做到配方接触分权、工序参数加密及人员离职时的书面交接，主张商业秘密在「保密措施」要件上极可能落空。 赔偿机制应明确违约救济与举证责任，具体协议条款以最新官方文本为准。
ask-trade-secret-protection.lead_en: The factory is prepared to execute an NDA, yet a robust non-leakage framework must rely on granular evidence. A standalone NDA is insufficient without technical controls such as compartmentalized formula access, encrypted process parameters, and documented off-boarding handovers. Confidentiality measures must be demonstrable. Infringement compensation mechanisms must specify remedies and burden of proof, subject to current legal texts.

sections.h_zh: NDA 与保密条款的颗粒度界定
sections.b_zh: 协议须明确界定保密信息范围，区分原料清单与核心工艺参数（温度、剪切条件等），并设定返还销毁义务与违约救济条款，不可仅作形式上的概括性承诺。
sections.b_en: Agreements must delineate the scope, distinguishing ingredient lists from core process parameters (temperature, shear). Return, destruction, and breach remedies are required; blanket promises are insufficient.

sections.h_zh: 生产环节的配方保密管理流程
sections.b_zh: 帛卉基于 ISO 22716 标准，对生产环节实施配方接触分权与文件加密。关键工序数据留有外发记录，通过分权管理控制研发、打样与品控各环节的知悉范围。
sections.b_en: BIOSPHERE enforces access compartmentalization and document encryption based on ISO 22716. Critical process data logging and access control ensure limited visibility across R&D and QC stages.

sections.h_zh: 侵权赔偿机制与离职应对
sections.b_zh: 保密协议需约定侵权赔偿标准与举证路径。针对离职风险，须明确离职前保密义务延续期限及离职交接清单，作为后续主张权利的底层证据。
sections.b_en: NDAs must stipulate compensation metrics and evidentiary paths. For turnover, specify post-departure confidentiality duration and handover checklists as foundational evidence.

faqs.q_zh: 保密协议是否包含竞业限制条款？
faqs.a_zh: 保密与竞业限制属不同法律范畴，需单独约定，以书面协议为准。
faqs.q_en: Does the NDA include non-compete clauses?
faqs.a_en: Confidentiality and non-compete are distinct; specific terms depend on the final written agreement.

faqs.q_zh: 工厂现有保密体系能否完全杜绝泄露？
faqs.a_zh: 保密体系旨在降低风险并留痕，无法提供绝对免责担保。
faqs.q_en: Can existing systems fully prevent leaks?
faqs.a_en: Systems mitigate risk and ensure documentation; they do not offer absolute liability guarantees.

ask-dg-shipping-alkohol-spray.q_zh: 含75%酒精的喷雾类洁面产品出口到欧洲，需符合IATA危险品运输规定，工厂能否提供最新的MSDS文件，并协助规划FBA入仓时的清关与温控方案？
ask-dg-shipping-alkohol-spray.q_en: For a spray-based cleanser containing 75% alcohol exported to Europe, it must comply with IATA DG shipping regulations. Can the factory provide the latest MSDS and assist in planning FBA inbound clearance and temperature control?
ask-dg-shipping-alkohol-spray.lead_zh: 该产品含75%酒精并采用喷雾包装，须按IATA危险品运输规定作为可燃液体处理。 工厂可提供合规的MSDS与最新运输鉴定报告（含闪点、UN编号），但FBA入仓前置条件包括：欧盟责任人指定、CPNP通报及清关文件齐备；温控方案需避免极端高温，采用加强型缓冲包装。 所有清关责任由目的国进口商或指定责任人承担。
ask-dg-shipping-alkohol-spray.lead_en: A 75% alcohol spray cleanser is classified as a flammable liquid under IATA DG regulations. The factory can provide up-to-date MSDS and a transport identification report (flash point, UN number). However, FBA inbound clearance requires a designated EU Responsible Person and prior CPNP notification. Temperature control should be maintained with reinforced packaging to prevent extreme heat effects. Customs clearance liability falls on the EU importer or appointed Responsible Person.

sections.h_zh: IATA危险品合规与MSDS文件支持
sections.b_zh: 工厂基于ISO 22716及36项质检体系出具MSDS，标注闪点、UN编号与运输分类；危险品申报须基于实测数据，不可按普货申报。
sections.b_en: Factory issues MSDS with flash point, UN number, and transport classification based on ISO 22716. DG declaration must rely on tested data; general-cargo misclassification is prohibited.

sections.h_zh: FBA清关前置条件与责任人安排
sections.b_zh: 清关前需完成欧盟责任人指定、CPNP通报及标签合规；建议指定具备危险品处理资质的海外仓，确认准入流程与退运政策。
sections.h_en: FBA Clearance Prerequisites & Responsible Person Setup
sections.b_en: Ensure EU Responsible Person designation, CPNP notification, and label compliance before clearance. Use a DG-capable 3PL and verify their refusal policies.

sections.h_zh: 高温敏感与运输温控防损设计
sections.b_zh: 喷雾罐在夏季高温港口易膨胀泄漏；外箱需增加跌落缓冲与堆码设计，避免顶层挂柜，采用防倾倒包装以控制破损率。
sections.b_en: Spray cans risk pressure buildup in heat. Use drop-proof and stack-resistant packaging, avoid top-tier slots, and use tilt-prevention designs to reduce breakage.

faqs.q_zh: 若FBA仓拒收含酒精喷雾品怎么办？
faqs.a_zh: 需转仓至具备DG准入的第三方仓或销毁；成本由发方承担，建议提前确认仓方政策。
faqs.q_en: What if an FBA warehouse refuses the alcohol spray item?
faqs.a_en: Transfer to a DG-approved 3PL or destroy. Costs fall on the shipper; confirm warehouse policy in advance.

faqs.q_zh: 欧盟责任人必须在发货前完成哪些操作？
faqs.a_zh: 完成CPNP通报、指定责任人、确保本地标签语言合规，所有步骤须在口岸抽查前闭环。
faqs.q_en: What must the EU Responsible Person do before shipment?
faqs.a_en: Complete CPNP notification, appoint the RP, and ensure local label language compliance before port inspection.

ask-exclusive-contract-mold-cost.q_zh: 我们计划独家代理这款新品，合同中关于模具费分摊与配方独占条款如何设定，才能最大程度保护小品牌方的利益？
ask-exclusive-contract-mold-cost.q_en: For our exclusive agency of this new product, how should we structure mold cost sharing and formula exclusivity to best protect a small brand's interests?
ask-exclusive-contract-mold-cost.lead_zh: 小品牌方若承担模具费，模具产权归品牌方，工厂仅实物保管并需约定闲置移交；配方独占必须以「独占对价 + 年度最低采购量 + 考核期」为前提，未达标自动转非独占。 责任上限锁定货款，排除间接损失；质量异议期 30 天加留样复检。 法规与条款以最新官方文本为准，具体以书面报价为准。
ask-exclusive-contract-mold-cost.lead_en: If the brand bears mold fees, ownership stays with the brand; the factory only stores them with clear handover terms. Formula exclusivity must be tied to minimum annual volume and a review period, converting to non-exclusive if targets are missed. Liability caps at invoice value, excluding indirect losses; quality claims follow a 30-day window with retained samples. Clauses follow latest official texts; specifics per written quotation.

sections.b_zh: 品牌方全额支付模具费，模具产权归品牌，实物由工厂保管。合同写明闲置处置：结清货款、承担拆装运输费用后移交。若分摊，产权归工厂，品牌获排他使用权。
sections.b_en: Brand funds mold fees; ownership remains with brand. Factory stores molds. Idling terms: clear all dues, brand pays dismantling/shipping for handover. If shared, factory owns; brand gets exclusive use.

sections.b_zh: 独占瓶型或配方须绑定年度最低采购量与考核期。未达量自动转非独占。独占对价需覆盖工厂放弃其他客户的机会成本，避免免费锁产能。
sections.b_en: Exclusive bottle or formula must bind to annual minimums and review periods. Failure auto-converts to non-exclusive. Compensation must offset factory's opportunity cost, preventing free capacity lock.

sections.b_zh: 责任上限设为订单货款，排除间接损失。质量异议期 30 天，附双方留样复检机制。适用中国法，广州仲裁/诉讼。配方来源合法性由委托方承担风险。
sections.b_en: Liability capped at invoice value, excluding indirect losses. 30-day quality claim window with dual retained samples for third-party testing. Chinese law, Guangzhou arbitration/litigation. Client bears formula source legality risks.

faqs.q_zh: 定金与尾款比例怎么定？
faqs.a_zh: 新客户首单建议预付定金，发货前付清余款。定金需覆盖原料与开模支出，具体比例以书面报价为准。
faqs.q_en: How to set deposit and balance ratios?
faqs.a_en: For new clients, use deposit plus pre-shipment balance. Deposit must cover materials and tooling. Specific ratios per written quotation.

faqs.q_zh: 独占期内能改配方吗？
faqs.a_zh: 独家代理期修改配方需重新评估独占对价与采购量。若配方变更，原独占权失效，按新条款重新绑定。
faqs.q_en: Can formula change during exclusivity?
faqs.a_en: Formula changes require reassessing exclusivity pricing and volumes. Original exclusivity lapses; new terms must be re-bound.

ask-nmpa-whitening-audit-risk.q_zh: 这款美白精华的备案资料已经备齐了，但根据目前药监的审评趋势，哪些部分最容易被打回补正？整体周期会拉长吗？
ask-nmpa-whitening-audit-risk.q_en: Our whitening serum filing is ready, but based on current NMPA review trends, which parts are most likely to be rejected for correction, and will the timeline be extended?
ask-nmpa-whitening-audit-risk.lead_zh: 含「美白」宣称的精华属特殊化妆品，审评最易发补的三处：配方表/标签/检验报告/执行标准四者信息不一致；功效证据档次不足以支撑美白宣称（如用消费者使用测试撑「祛斑美白」）；安全评估链条断裂（原料商安全信息缺失）。 发补将拉长周期，答复窗口期应预留补做人体试验的最长时长，无法承诺具体拿证时间。
ask-nmpa-whitening-audit-risk.lead_en: A whitening serum is a special cosmetic under NMPA. The three most likely correction triggers: (1) mismatch among formula sheet, label, test report, and execution standard; (2) efficacy evidence tier below the claim tier (e. g. , using consumer-use test to back a whitening claim); (3) broken safety-assessment chain (missing raw-material supplier safety data). A correction request will extend the timeline; reserve a window for the longest possible in-vivo retest. No approval date can be promised.

sections.b_zh: 配方表、标签样稿、检验报告、产品执行标准中净含量、pH、有效成分含量、使用方法、保质期、生产企业等任一信息不一致，是审评员最先比对的高风险点；提交前完成四表逐条核对。
sections.b_en: Any mismatch in net volume, pH, active-concentrate content, usage, shelf-life, or manufacturer across the formula sheet, label draft, test report, and execution standard is the first high-risk point reviewers check; complete a line-by-line cross-check before submission.

sections.b_zh: 「美白/祛斑」宣称需按特殊化妆品注册路径准备，人体功效评价试验是最强支撑；若以消费者使用测试或文献数据去撑该等级宣称，大概率触发发补，建议提交前主动降档改写。
sections.b_en: A whitening or spot-removal claim must follow the special-cosmetic registration path; in-vivo efficacy trials provide the strongest evidence. If the claim is backed by consumer-use testing or literature data only, a correction is highly likely; proactively downgrade the claim before submission.

sections.b_zh: 每个原料的供应商安全信息码或等效资料是安全评估资料链的必要环节，缺失即构成资料完整性退回的常见原因；应将安全信息报送作为配方定版的前置准入条件，而非提交前才催办。
sections.b_en: Each raw material's supplier safety data (safety information code or equivalent) is a required link in the safety-assessment file; gaps here are a common reason for completeness rejection. Treat supplier safety-data submission as a gating condition at formula freeze, not as a last-minute task.

faqs.q_zh: 发补后能补充多轮材料吗？
faqs.a_zh: 应按一次性答复对待：逐条对应、只答所问，不主动扩大解释范围；补充引出新问题是二次发补的常见成因。
faqs.q_en: Can multiple rounds of materials be submitted after a correction notice?
faqs.a_en: Treat it as a one-time response: address each point, answer only what is asked, do not expand scope; new issues introduced by the response are the common cause of a second round.

faqs.q_zh: 境外已上市，能否直接沿用境外审评资料？
faqs.a_zh: 境内申报与境外备案的体例、术语、证据接受度不同，两套文档需独立规划；若配方有差异，须提交一致性说明。
faqs.q_en: The product is already marketed overseas - can the foreign review file be reused directly?
faqs.a_en: Domestic and overseas filings use different formats, terminology, and evidence standards; two independent document sets should be planned from the start. Any formula differences require a consistency explanation.

ask-vacuum-bottle-seal-shipping.q_zh: 为了应对海运到港后的漏液问题，选真空瓶时泵头和瓶口的密封结构具体要注意什么参数？
ask-vacuum-bottle-seal-shipping.q_en: To prevent leaks during sea shipping, what specific pump head and bottle neck sealing parameters should I pay attention to when selecting vacuum bottles?
ask-vacuum-bottle-seal-shipping.lead_zh: 真空瓶海运漏液风险主要源于泵头与瓶口密封面的失效。 关键参数包括：泵头回气结构、瓶口螺纹扭矩、内塞材质及铝箔封口方式。 建议在灌装线进行气密性测试，确保密封面平整且扭矩在合规区间，以降低运输中的渗漏概率。 具体方案需结合料体粘度与物流条件确定。
ask-vacuum-bottle-seal-shipping.lead_en: Leakage in vacuum bottles during sea shipping often stems from pump head and bottle neck seal failures. Critical parameters include pump head air-return structure, thread torque, inner cap material, and aluminum foil sealing methods. Conduct airtightness tests on the filling line to ensure flat seals and compliant torque, minimizing leakage risks. Specific solutions depend on viscosity and logistics conditions.

sections.b_zh: 泵头必须具备顺畅的回气结构，防止内部形成负压导致出料中断。出量精度需符合标准，避免残留量过大。回气孔设计需与料体粘度匹配，高粘度料体需优化泵头内部流道。
sections.b_en: Pump heads must feature smooth air-return structures to prevent negative pressure and interruption. Dispensing precision must meet standards to minimize residue. Air-return hole design must match viscosity; high-viscosity materials require optimized internal flow channels.

sections.b_zh: 瓶口材质需与封口方式匹配。电磁感应封口要求PP/PE口面平整无飞边；PET/PETG则需采用压敏垫或复合垫片。螺纹扭矩应控制在8–18 kgf·cm区间，灌装线需抽检，防止运输振动导致回松渗漏。
sections.b_en: Bottle material must match the sealing method. Electromagnetic induction sealing requires flat PP/PE necks; PET/PETG needs pressure-sensitive pads or composite gaskets. Thread torque must be controlled within 8–18 kgf·cm, with spot checks on the filling line to prevent leakage from vibration.

sections.b_zh: 严禁仅用水测试。需使用实料进行回弹与残留测试，模拟货舱低压环境。若含挥发性成分，需进行45℃正倒置与低压试验。供应商变更或模具更换后，必须重新做气密验证，不得沿用旧报告。
sections.b_en: Water-only testing is prohibited. Conduct rebound and residue tests with actual materials, simulating cargo hold low pressure. For volatile content, perform 45°C inversion and low-pressure tests. Re-validate airtightness after supplier or mold changes; do not reuse old reports.

faqs.q_zh: 真空瓶残留量投诉如何解决？
faqs.a_zh: 需优化活塞结构，增加刮料片设计，并在灌装后静置测试残留率。
faqs.q_en: How to resolve vacuum bottle residue complaints?
faqs.a_en: Optimize piston structure, add scraper design, and test residue rates after static resting post-filling.

faqs.q_zh: 空运是否允许？
faqs.a_zh: 含醇或气雾产品未经低压与温度循环验证，不得出具空运结论。
faqs.q_en: Is air freight permitted?
faqs.a_en: Alcohol-containing or aerosol products cannot be cleared for air freight without low-pressure and temperature cycle verification.

ask-emulsion-scale-up-vc.q_zh: 我从小样确认的配方转到大货时，怎么保证乳化膏体的粘度不会出现批次差异？代工厂的放大工艺细节是怎样的？
ask-emulsion-scale-up-vc.q_en: When scaling up from a confirmed sample to mass production, how do you ensure emulsion viscosity consistency? What are your scale-up process details?
ask-emulsion-scale-up-vc.lead_zh: 跨量级放大必须插档中试，且以线速度与单位体积能量输入替代单纯转速匹配。 含剪切敏感增稠体系需严控均质阶段与低温区结晶速度，热敏组分实行降温后硬控投料。 最终粘度差异先溯源工艺记录而非改配方，确保批次一致性。
ask-emulsion-scale-up-vc.lead_en: Scaling up requires an intermediate pilot step and matching linear velocity rather than RPM. Systems with shear-sensitive thickeners need strict control of homogenization and cooling rates to prevent crystal coarsening. Heat-sensitive actives must be added after cooling to hard control points. Viscosity deviations should be traced to process history before formulating changes.

sections.b_zh: 实验室低于5升直接跳至500升以上必须插入50至100升中试。跨两个数量级时搅拌雷诺数与传热比不可线性外推，粒径与粘度会同时漂移。中试通过方可开千升锅。
sections.b_en: Jumping from under 5L to over 500L requires a 50-100L pilot. Reynolds numbers and heat transfer ratios do not scale linearly across two orders of magnitude, causing simultaneous particle size and viscosity drift.

sections.b_zh: 均质仅限乳化阶段，中和增稠后改低速搅拌防止高分子链断裂。降温速率决定晶体网络，慢降致晶体粗大影响稳定性。真空乳化需全程脱气防止气泡导致粘度虚高与灌装偏差。
sections.b_en: Homogenization is limited to emulsification; switch to low-speed stirring after neutralization to prevent polymer chain scission. Cooling rates dictate crystal networks; slow cooling causes coarse crystals. Vacuum is essential to prevent viscosity inflation.

sections.b_zh: 大货粘度差异超20%时，先取上中下三层测粘度与pH定位乳化或降温问题，而非直接改配方。若因批间波动超标，必须停线复核，严禁通过临时补料掩盖，否则货架期内会以析水形式爆发。
sections.b_en: If viscosity deviates by over 20%, test top, middle, and bottom layers for viscosity and pH to locate emulsification or cooling issues before reformulating. If inter-batch variation exceeds limits, stop the line; masking defects leads to later instability.

faqs.q_zh: 换乳化锅时转速要改吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能照抄转速，需按新设备线速度重新计算。
faqs.q_en: Do we adjust RPM when changing mixers?
faqs.a_en: No, do not copy RPMs; recalculate based on the new equipment's linear velocity.

faqs.q_zh: 中试不合格能直接开大货吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能，必须解决中试差异并复核工艺后方可量产。
faqs.q_en: Can we skip to mass production if the pilot fails?
faqs.a_en: No, mass production is prohibited until pilot discrepancies are resolved and the process is revalidated.

ask-europe-retailer-gmp-audit.q_zh: 如果我们准备去欧洲大型零售商验厂，除了ISO 22716证书，你们能提供哪些具体的SOP和偏差管理文件来满足审厂要求？
ask-europe-retailer-gmp-audit.q_en: If we audit for a major European retailer, what specific SOPs and deviation management documents can you provide to meet the audit requirements?
ask-europe-retailer-gmp-audit.lead_zh: ISO 22716“按标准建立体系”不等于“持有证书”，客户验厂通常按零售商自有标准核查；审核重点集中在“写、做、记”一致性，具体会查阅偏差与 CAPA 闭环记录、设备清洁效果确认文件及留样管理规程。 帛卉持有 GMPC、ISO 22716、HALAL 证书。FDA 是设施注册协助，注册≠批准、不发证书。EU CPNP 是通报，SGS 是第三方检测。 现场审若产线空转，需如实说明排期并提供近期同类产品的完整批记录。
ask-europe-retailer-gmp-audit.lead_en: Claiming to 'establish a system according to ISO 22716' is distinct from 'holding a certificate'; European retailers audit based on their own standards. The focus is on whether written, practical, and recorded processes align. Auditors will check deviation and CAPA closure records, equipment cleaning validation, and sample retention SOPs. BioSphere holds GMPC, ISO 22716 and HALAL certificates. FDA is facility-registration assistance: registration is not approval, and no certificate is issued. EU CPNP is notification and SGS is third-party testing. If the audit day finds lines idle, actual production schedules and recent complete batch records for similar products must be provided.

sections.b_zh: 必须提供偏差发生后的调查记录与 CAPA 闭环文件。隐瞒偏差历史等同于数据造假，若被查出，体系将直接失去可信度，是审计中的致命项。
sections.b_en: Provide post-incident investigation and CAPA closure documents. Concealing historical deviations equates to data falsification; if discovered, the system is deemed untrustworthy, a critical fatal defect.

sections.b_zh: 需提供设备清洁 SOP 及其清洁验证或效果确认记录。仅有规程而无验证记录是高频不符合项，因为规定了不等于证明有效。
sections.b_en: Provide equipment cleaning SOPs and cleaning validation or effect confirmation records. Having a procedure without validation is a high-frequency non-conformance, as 'defined' does not mean 'proven effective'.

sections.b_zh: 批生产记录中关键工艺参数需有实测值，仅打勾无效。留样保存期应短于「货架期+6个月」，留样量需够做两次全项复检。
sections.b_en: Key process parameters in batch records must have measured values; ticking boxes is invalid. Retention periods must exceed 'shelf-life + 6 months' and quantities suffice for two full re-tests.

faqs.q_zh: ISO 22716 证书能提供吗？
faqs.a_zh: 帛卉官网口径显示已持有 ISO 22716 证书。若客户需第三方特定体系认证，需先核实持有情况，不承诺不具备的认证。
faqs.q_en: Can you provide ISO 22716 certificates?
faqs.a_en: BioSphere's public info shows it holds ISO 22716 certificates. If clients require specific third-party certifications, verify possession first; no unheld certifications are promised.

faqs.q_zh: 如果审厂当天产线没生产怎么办？
faqs.a_zh: 应如实说明排期，不提供「样板线」，但需近期同类产品的完整批记录作为替代证据。
faqs.q_en: What if the audit line is idle?
faqs.a_en: State the schedule honestly. Avoid 'model lines', but provide complete batch records for similar recent products as alternative evidence.

ask-se-asean-label-conflict.q_zh: 我要把这款洗发水同时推向印尼和泰国市场，除了BPOM和FDA备案，还有没有其他的标签法规冲突需要提前处理？
ask-se-asean-label-conflict.q_en: If I launch this shampoo in both Indonesia and Thailand, are there any label regulation conflicts to handle besides BPOM and FDA notifications?
ask-se-asean-label-conflict.lead_zh: 结论：除 BPOM 通知外，核心冲突在于印尼强制清真认证（2026 年 10 月 17 日起）及标签法规 PerBPOM 18/2024。 若配方含动物源成分（如羊毛脂、动物甘油）或乙醇，需调整配方以获清真认证，否则须加印红色“NON HALAL”标识。 泰国标签无此强制要求，但需符合泰文法规。 最终合规取决于完整 INCI 表及宣称原文。
ask-se-asean-label-conflict.lead_en: Beyond BPOM notification, the key conflict is Indonesia's mandatory Halal certification (effective Oct 17, 2026) and labeling rules (PerBPOM 18/2024). Formulas with animal-derived ingredients (e. g. , lanolin, animal glycerin) or ethanol may require modification for Halal compliance; otherwise, a red 'NON HALAL' mark is mandatory. Thai labels do not have this specific requirement but must follow local Thai regulations. Final compliance depends on the complete INCI list and exact claim wording.

sections.h_zh: 印尼清真强制性与标签要求
sections.b_zh: 依 BPJPH 条例及 PP 42/2024，2026 年 10 月 17 日起化妆品须获清真认证。未获证产品须按 BPJPH 条例 3/2026 加印红色“NON HALAL”标识。PerBPOM 18/2024 规定印尼语标签须含功效、警示、成分及清真状态。以最新官方文本为准。
sections.b_en: Per BPJPH Regulation 3/2026 and PP 42/2024, cosmetics require Halal certification from Oct 17, 2026. Non-certified products must display a red 'NON HALAL' mark. PerBPOM 18/2024 mandates Bahasa Indonesia labels including benefits, warnings, ingredients, and Halal status. Check latest official texts.

sections.h_zh: 成分来源与配方兼容性
sections.b_zh: 若配方含动物来源原料（如羊毛脂、动物甘油、角鲨烷）或乙醇，清真认证难度极高。需替换为植物或发酵来源，并留存供应商声明。若维持原配方，则须接受“NON HALAL”标识，可能影响部分消费者购买意愿。
sections.b_en: Animal-derived ingredients (lanolin, animal glycerin, squalane) or ethanol make Halal certification difficult. Replace with plant/fermentation sources and retain supplier declarations. If retaining the formula, accept the 'NON HALAL' mark, which may impact consumer perception.

sections.h_zh: 泰国标签差异与双市场策略
sections.b_zh: 泰国法规无强制清真标识要求，但标签需符合泰文规定（成分、警告、责任人）。建议评估是否拆版生产：印尼版优化清真合规，泰国版保留原配方。若统一配方，需确保成分符合两国禁用/限用清单，以书面报价确认生产周期。
sections.b_en: Thailand does not mandate Halal labeling but requires Thai-language labels (ingredients, warnings, responsible person). Evaluate split production: Halal-optimized version for Indonesia, original formula for Thailand. If unifying, ensure ingredients meet both countries' prohibited/limited lists.

faqs.q_zh: 如果配方含乙醇，能否通过印尼清真认证？
faqs.a_zh: 取决于乙醇来源与残留量。植物来源乙醇较易通过，动物来源则需特殊说明。建议优先更换非酒精体系。以认证机构最新要求为准。
faqs.q_en: Can ethanol-containing formulas pass Indonesian Halal certification?
faqs.a_en: Depends on ethanol source and residue. Plant-based ethanol is easier; animal-based requires specific justification. Recommend replacing with non-alcohol systems. Follow latest certification authority requirements.

faqs.q_zh: 泰国和印尼的标签语言要求有何不同？
faqs.a_zh: 印尼标签必须使用印尼语（PerBPOM 18/2024），泰国必须使用泰文。双语包装需确保各国主要信息在前，避免互相冲突。以当地法规为准。
faqs.q_en: How do language requirements differ between Thai and Indonesian labels?
faqs.a_en: Indonesian labels must be in Bahasa Indonesia (PerBPOM 18/2024); Thai labels must be in Thai. Bilingual packaging must prioritize local language for key info to avoid conflicts. Follow local regulations.

sources.t: 各国法规 · 印度尼西亚

ask-cn-sensitive-skin-claims.q_zh: 这款主打“敏感肌可用”的护肤品在天猫上架时，详情页上的宣称词如何设计才能规避药监局对功效宣称的风险？
ask-cn-sensitive-skin-claims.q_en: For a 'sensitive skin' product on Tmall, how should we design our efficacy claims to avoid NMPA compliance risks?
ask-cn-sensitive-skin-claims.lead_zh: 敏感肌可用宣称需人体证据，天猫详情页属法定宣称载体。 依据《化妆品监督管理条例》，此类描述须提交人体功效评价试验或消费者使用测试报告。 文案需删除所有医疗暗示，仅保留合规感官描述，确保标签、详情、短视频话术一致。 未同步全渠道宣称清单或报告不匹配最终配方，将面临驳回或下架风险。 以最新官方文本为准。
ask-cn-sensitive-skin-claims.lead_en: Sensitive-skin claims require human efficacy evidence under NMPA regulations. The Tmall detail page is a statutory claim vehicle. The 'Cosmetics Supervision and Administration Regulations' mandate submitting human efficacy test or consumer usage test reports. Copy must remove all medical implications, retaining only compliant sensory descriptions. Ensure consistency across labels, details, and short videos. Failure to synchronize claims or match reports to final formulations risks rejection or delisting. Follow latest official texts.

sections.b_zh: 宣称「温和、舒缓、敏感肌适用」必须提供人体功效评价试验或消费者使用测试报告，体外实验仅作辅助。文案禁用「药妆、抗炎、医研级」等医疗暗示词，否则视为违规。证据须对应最终投产配方，任何调整导致报告作废。
sections.b_en: Claims of 'gentle, soothing, sensitive-skin' require human efficacy trials or consumer tests; in-vitro data is auxiliary only. Ban medical terms like 'pharmaceutical cosmetics' or 'anti-inflammatory'. Evidence must match the final production formula; any adjustment voids the report.

sections.b_zh: 天猫详情页、主图、短视频口播均受监管，宣称必须与备案内容一致。平台审核基于 NMPA 法规，出现禁用语或夸大功效将触发下架。需建立全渠道文案清单同步机制，确保电商宣传不超出备案批准的功效描述范围。
sections.b_en: Tmall detail pages, key visuals, and short-video scripts are all regulated. Claims must align with filed records. Platform audits follow NMPA rules; prohibited terms or exaggerated efficacy trigger delisting. Maintain a synchronized claim inventory across all channels to stay within approved filing scope.

sections.b_zh: 功效评价报告必须由具备资质的机构出具，日期与配方版本严格对应。若配方微调（如香精比例）而未重做报告，抽检时被认定为资料不实。新原料或敏感词出现时需重排时间轴，不可事后补证。以最新官方文本为准。
sections.b_en: Efficacy reports must be issued by qualified bodies with dates matching the formula version. Minor adjustments (e.g., fragrance ratio) without re-testing constitute false documentation. New ingredients or sensitive terms require timeline realignment; retroactive evidence is invalid. Follow latest official texts.

faqs.q_zh: 消费者使用测试可以完全替代人体功效试验吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。敏感肌类宣称要求人体层面证据，消费者使用测试需配合或独立作为人体证据，体外实验仅作辅助参考。
faqs.q_en: Can consumer usage tests fully replace human efficacy trials?
faqs.a_en: No. Sensitive-skin claims require human-level evidence; consumer tests serve as primary or complementary proof, while in-vitro data is auxiliary only.

faqs.q_zh: 电商详情页与包装标签宣称不一致会有处罚吗？
faqs.a_zh: 会。所有面向消费者的载体均属宣称范围，不一致可能导致备案资料不实认定，面临责令改正、罚款或下架风险。
faqs.q_en: Are penalties applied if e-commerce details differ from packaging labels?
faqs.a_en: Yes. All consumer-facing media are claim vehicles. Inconsistency may constitute false filing documentation, risking correction orders, fines, or delisting.

ask-eu-uk-sunscreen-compliance.q_zh: 如果我的防晒产品要卖到欧盟，CPNP备案时对于防晒指数SPF的测试标准（ISO 24444）与英国SCPN有何不同？
ask-eu-uk-sunscreen-compliance.q_en: For sunscreen entering the EU and UK, what are the differences in SPF testing standards (ISO 24444) between CPNP and SCPN?
ask-eu-uk-sunscreen-compliance.lead_zh: CPNP 与 SCPN 仅为合规通报渠道，不定义 SPF 测试方法。 两者均要求依据欧盟法规进行测试与标注。 需注意，现行 ISO 24444 标准正在被新版本替代，新版将采用 5cm 涂抹系数而非 1mg/cm2，导致 SPF 值发生显著偏移。 买手需确认供应商出具的检测依据是现行版还是 2025/26 实施版。
ask-eu-uk-sunscreen-compliance.lead_en: CPNP and SCPN are notification portals, not testing standards. Both require SPF testing per EU regulations. Note that the current ISO 24444 is being replaced; the new version uses a 5 cm application rate, significantly altering SPF values. Verify if lab reports cite the current or the 2025/26 implementation version.

sections.h_zh: 通报渠道与标准的区分
sections.b_zh: CPNP 为欧盟通报，SCPN 为英国独立通报。两者均引用法规文本，不直接规定测试方法。方法依据来自化妆品法规对防晒产品的专项要求，需按最新版标准执行。
sections.b_en: CPNP (EU) and SCPN (UK) are notification tools, not testing methods. Both rely on current EU regulations. Always verify the specific version of the standard used.

sections.b_zh: 现行标准 ISO 24444 正在被修订，新版将采用 5cm 涂抹系数。同一防晒产品在新旧标准下测得的 SPF 值不可直接对比，新数据通常高于旧数据。需明确合同锁定标准版本。
sections.b_en: Current ISO 24444 is being replaced. The new version uses a 5 cm application rate, making SPF values incomparable. Lock the standard version in the contract.

sections.b_zh: 若宣称 SPF，必须同步标注 UVA 防护值。UVA 值不得低于 SPF 的三分之一。标签语言需符合成员国要求，成分表需列出过敏原。英国脱欧后需单独在英国境内指定责任人。
sections.b_en: SPF claims require UVA protection values (min 1/3 of SPF). Labeling languages must follow local rules. UK requires a separate UK Responsible Person post-Brexit.

faqs.q_zh: SPF 测试由谁负责？
faqs.a_zh: 必须由欧盟境内指定的责任人委托有资质的实验室执行，出具 CRO/PIF 文件。
faqs.q_en: Who is responsible for SPF testing?
faqs.a_en: Must be commissioned by the Responsible Person to a qualified lab, with results stored in the PIF.

faqs.q_zh: 英国和欧盟的测试数据可以通用吗？
faqs.a_zh: 技术数据可共享，但合规义务需拆分：需分别完成 CPNP 和 SCPN 通报，并满足双方当地责任人体系。
faqs.q_en: Can UK and EU SPF data be shared?
faqs.a_en: Lab data is universal, but compliance is split: separate CPNP and SCPN notifications, plus different local Responsible Persons.
