ask-sheet-mask-attachment-stability.q_zh: 给东南亚市场的贴片面膜换膜布材质和灌注量，怎么确保不同脸型都贴得稳且运输途中不漏液？
ask-sheet-mask-attachment-stability.q_en: How do we ensure fit for various face shapes and prevent leakage during shipping when changing the sheet mask fabric material and serum fill volume for our Southeast Asian market?
ask-sheet-mask-attachment-stability.lead_zh: 更换膜布材质与灌注量需基于目标脸型实测数据与运输稳定性验证。 东南亚市场脸型数据较少，优先选用具备良好弹性与吸液均匀度的天丝或铜氨纤维，通过开模优化贴合度。 灌注量需重新标定为该批次膜布饱和吸液量的约1. 2倍，采用铝箔复合袋封装并优化封口参数，确保高温高湿环境下的运输防漏性能。
ask-sheet-mask-attachment-stability.lead_en: Material and fill volume changes require real-world facial data and transport stability testing. For Southeast Asia, prioritizing modal or cupro with good elasticity is advised. The fill volume should be recalibrated to approximately 1. 2 times the saturation capacity of the specific fabric batch. Aluminum laminated pouches with optimized sealing parameters are essential to prevent leakage under high-temperature, high-humidity shipping conditions.

sections.b_zh: 针对东南亚脸型建立3D数据模型，优先采用天丝/铜氨材质配合定制刀模。首单若量小，可使用通用版模具并将贴合度列为风险提示。
sections.b_en: Build 3D models for Southeast Asian facial features; prioritize modal/cupro fabrics with custom dies. For small initial orders, use universal dies and explicitly note fit risks in documentation.

sections.b_zh: 严禁照抄行业惯用数字。按当批膜布克重公差实测吸液倍率，取1.1至1.3倍区间，平衡“干涩/滴漏”两端，确保开袋即用。
sections.b_en: Never copy generic figures. Measure actual absorption multiples based on batch fabric weight tolerance, aiming for the 1.1 to 1.3 range to balance dryness against leakage.

sections.b_zh: 东南亚长海运必须使用不透明铝箔复合袋。灌装时严控精华污染封口区，定期监测封口温度、压力与时间参数，防止货架期内渗漏。
sections.b_en: Long-haul maritime shipping to SEA mandates opaque aluminum composite pouches. Prevent serum contamination at seal zones and monitor temperature, pressure, and time parameters to ensure shelf-life integrity.

faqs.q_zh: 如果膜布带有浆味或纸味如何处理？
faqs.a_zh: 排查来料批次与仓储湿度，严禁通过添加香精掩盖异味，以免掩盖潜在的微生物变质信号。
faqs.q_en: How to handle paper or starch odors in the fabric?
faqs.a_en: Investigate incoming batch and warehouse humidity. Strictly prohibit masking odors with fragrances to avoid hiding early signs of microbial spoilage.

faqs.q_zh: 运输途中出现少量滴液，是材料还是工艺问题？
faqs.a_zh: 多为灌装工艺问题，如封口温度/压力参数漂移或封口区污染，需优先排查工艺控制记录。
faqs.q_en: Is minor leakage during transit a material or process issue?
faqs.a_en: Usually a process issue, such as seal temperature/pressure drift or seal zone contamination; prioritize auditing process control records.

id-skincare-oem.q_zh: 在印尼上市一款护肤产品(精华 / 面霜),代工厂要准备哪些资料、备案多久能拿到编号?
id-skincare-oem.q_en: Launching a skincare product (serum or cream) in Indonesia: what does the OEM factory need to prepare, and how long does notification take?
id-skincare-oem.lead_zh: 印尼护肤产品上市须由印尼境内法人（进口商/持证方）在 BPOM Notifkos 系统提交 pre-market notification（化妆品申报），配方须符合 PerBPOM 25/2025 原料限制（最迟 2026-10-03 达标），标签必须印尼语（PerBPOM 18/2024，2024-11-15 生效）。 工厂（OEM）需出具授权信、GMP/CPKB 证明及原料合规数据；但编号核发周期以最新 BPOM 官方公告为准，不承诺固定天数。 自 2026-10-17 起清真认证（BPJPH）强制，无证书前包装禁止出现 Halal 标识。
id-skincare-oem.lead_en: For skincare launch in Indonesia, an Indonesian legal entity (importer/license holder) must submit a pre-market notification via BPOM's Notifkos e-system. Formula must meet ingredient limits under PerBPOM 25/2025 (deadline 2026-10-03), and labels require Bahasa Indonesia (PerBPOM 18/2024, in force 2024-11-15). The OEM factory must prepare a letter of authorisation, GMP/CPKB proof, and raw-material compliance data. Notification processing time is based on the latest official BPOM announcement; no fixed days are promised. Halal certification by BPJPH becomes mandatory for all cosmetics from 2026-10-17; no Halal marks on labels before certificate is issued.

sections.b_zh: 工厂提交 BPOM 申报的法定主体必须为印尼境内法人；工厂需提供：1) 印尼责任方出具并盖钢章的 letter of authorisation；2) 符合 CPKB/GMP 的体系证明（ISO 22716 或当地 CPKB 编号）；3) 每款产品/变体的配方表（含 INCI 名与百分比）、原料合规声明及供应商来源文件；4) 既往安全评估、稳定性与微生物测试报告（防腐挑战 ISO 11930 / USP <51>）；5) 标签与宣称样稿（中英文对照，含印尼语版）。
sections.h_en: Documents the OEM factory must prepare
sections.b_en: The legal entity submitting to BPOM must be an Indonesian corporate body. The factory must provide: 1) a stamped letter of authorisation from the local responsible party; 2) GMP/CPKB compliance proof (ISO 22716 or local CPKB No.); 3) formulation sheet with INCI names and percentages, plus raw-material compliance and supplier sourcing files; 4) prior safety assessment, stability and microbial test reports (challenge per ISO 11930 / USP <51>); 5) label and claim drafts in Chinese, English and Bahasa Indonesia.

sections.b_zh: BPOM Notifkos 申报编号的核发周期不承诺固定天数，以 BPOM 最新官方公告与系统实际处理状态为准。费用：ASEAN 产产品 IDR 500,000 / 非 ASEAN 产产品 IDR 1,500,000（每次申报与变体计一次）。申报有效期 3 年。
sections.b_en: The issuance timing of BPOM Notifkos reference numbers is not committed to a fixed number of days; it follows the latest official BPOM announcement and actual system processing status. Fees: IDR 500,000 for ASEAN-made / IDR 1,500,000 for non-ASEAN-made products, charged per notification and variant. Validity: 3 years. The client must accept shipment deferral if the reference number has not been issued, and should not write fixed issuance dates into contract delivery clauses.

sections.b_zh: 自 2026-10-17 起 BPJPH 清真认证为化妆品全品类强制（PP 42/2024）；未取得证书前，任何包装稿、样品与电商图不得出现 Halal 标识或字样。非清真产品须在 12 个月过渡期后加印红色「NON HALAL」标识（BPJPH Regulation 3/2026）。标签法定最低要求：印尼语的功效、使用与警示语，完整原料列表、申报编号、批次、保质期、厂名进口商名（PerBPOM 18/2024，2024-11-15 生效，以最新官方文本为准）。
sections.b_en: From 2026-10-17, BPJPH halal certification becomes mandatory for all cosmetics (PP 42/2024). Before certificate issuance, no packaging drafts, samples or e-commerce images may display Halal marks or wording. Non-halal products must carry a red 'NON HALAL' mark after a 12-month transition period (BPJPH Regulation 3/2026). Minimum legal label requirements: Indonesian-language benefits, directions and warnings, full ingredient list, notification number, batch, expiry, and manufacturer/importer names (PerBPOM 18/2024, in force 2024-11-15; subject to the latest official text).

faqs.q_zh: 中国已有备案能否直接拿来用？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。境内备案仅对中国境内销售有效，编号在 BPOM 系统中无法律地位，须按印尼通道重新申报。
faqs.q_en: Can China's domestic filing be used directly?
faqs.a_en: No. Domestic filing is only valid for sales in China; its reference number holds no legal status in the BPOM system. A new Indonesian notification is required.

faqs.q_zh: 工厂能否自己持证申报？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。法定责任人须为印尼境内法人（进口商/持证方），OEM 工厂不担任境内持证主体。
faqs.q_en: Can the OEM factory itself hold the licence and apply?
faqs.a_en: No. The legal responsible party must be an Indonesian corporate entity (importer or licence holder). The OEM factory does not act as the domestic licence holder.

sources.t: 各国法规 · 印度尼西亚

id-hair-care-oem.q_zh: 在印尼做清真洗发水 / 护发素代工,配方要核哪些原料、清真认证和备案各要多久?
id-hair-care-oem.q_en: Halal shampoo and conditioner OEM for Indonesia: which ingredients are checked, and how long do halal certification and notification take?
id-hair-care-oem.lead_zh: 印尼法规强制要求化妆品通过BPOM备案，并逐步落实Halal强制认证。 配方需剔除动物源原料（如明胶、动物油脂）及未明确来源的乙醇，建议采用植物或发酵来源。 认证周期受审核排期影响，需尽早启动；备案周期取决于资料完备度与审核队列。
id-hair-care-oem.lead_en: Indonesian regulations mandate BPOM notification and a phased Halal certification transition for cosmetics. Formulations must exclude animal-derived ingredients (e. g. , gelatin, tallow) and unverified ethanol, favoring plant or fermented sources. Certification cycles depend on audit scheduling, requiring early action; notification timelines vary based on document completeness and queues.

sections.b_zh: 需剔除动物源成分（明胶、羊毛脂、胭脂虫红等），评估乙醇来源与残留量。建议全配方按欧盟附录预筛，确保无硬性禁用成分，留存供应商来源声明备查。
sections.b_en: Remove animal-derived ingredients (gelatin, lanolin, carmine) and assess ethanol sources. Prescreen per EU Annexes, ensure no hard bans, and retain supplier declarations for audit readiness.

sections.b_zh: 印尼 Halal 认证由 BPJPH 主导，化妆品强制实施节点以官方最新公告为准。若产品标注 Halal，需通过工厂级审核；使用非酒精体系或提供明确残留说明以降低驳回风险。
sections.b_en: BPJPH-led Halal certification enforcement dates depend on official bulletins. 'Halal' labeling requires facility audits; use alcohol-free systems or declare residue limits to reduce rejection risks.

sections.b_zh: 进口备案需印尼境内法定责任人（进口商或授权持有人）发起。资料需含印尼语标签、INCI 列表、毒理安全评估。备案系统为电子通知，周期依队列动态调整，无固定承诺时间。
sections.b_en: Notifications require an Indonesian legal entity as the responsible party. Submit Indonesian labels, INCI lists, and safety assessments. E-notification cycles are queue-based; no fixed timeline is guaranteed.

faqs.q_zh: 中国备案能否替代印尼 BPOM？
faqs.a_zh: 不能，各辖区独立，需按印尼系统重新提交。
faqs.q_en: Does China filing replace BPOM?
faqs.a_en: No, jurisdictions are separate; resubmission to Indonesia's system is required.

faqs.q_zh: 配方含乙醇能过 Halal 吗？
faqs.a_zh: 取决于来源与残留量，需通过认证机构判定。
faqs.q_en: Can ethanol pass Halal?
faqs.a_en: Depends on source and residual amount, subject to audit body assessment.

sources.t: 各国法规 · 印度尼西亚

id-sun-care-oem.q_zh: 在印尼卖防晒产品,SPF / PA 检测报告要哪一种、备案怎么走?
id-sun-care-oem.q_en: Selling sunscreen in Indonesia: which SPF / PA test report is accepted, and how is the product notified?
id-sun-care-oem.lead_zh: 印尼防晒产品上市前须通过主管机构 BPOM 的化妆品事前通报系统 (Notifikasi kosmetika) 完成备案，依据 PerBPOM No. 21/2022 及相关法规。 关于 SPF/PA 检测，印尼现行法规要求防晒产品的 SP 值必须由符合 CTS 1625 标准的体外测定方法得出，PA 等级需参照临界波长测定。 标签必须包含 BPOM 通报号及印尼文功效说明。 申请主体须为印尼境内法人，并满足即将强制实施的印尼 Halal 认证新规，最终以最新官方文本为准。
id-sun-care-oem.lead_en: Sunscreen products in Indonesia require pre-market notification via BPOM's Notifkos e-system, per BPOM Regulation No. 21/2022 and Health Law No. 17/2023. SPF values must be determined by standardized in-vitro methods (CTS 1625), and PA ratings require critical wavelength assessment. Labels must include the BPOM notification number and Indonesian text. The applicant must be an Indonesian legal entity, and BPJPH halal certification is mandatory from 2026, subject to the latest official texts.

sections.b_zh: 需通过 BPOM 的 Notifikasi kosmetika 系统完成事前通报，申请人须为印尼境内法人。需缴纳 IDR 1,500,000 费用，通报有效期 3 年。最终包材与标签须符合印尼文规定。
sections.b_en: Requires pre-market notification via BPOM's Notifikasi system. The applicant must be an Indonesian legal entity. The fee is IDR 1,500,000, and the notification is valid for 3 years.

sections.h_zh: SPF 与 PA 检测标准
sections.b_zh: SPF values require in-vitro transmittance testing based on CTS 1625. PA ratings are determined by UVA critical wavelength. Testing must follow final formulation stability; labels must state tested values.
自 2026-10-17 起，化妆品须强制获得 BPJPH 颁发的 Halal 认证；未获认证者须标注红色“NON HALAL”。同时须符合印尼 CPKB/GMP 生产标准。
sections.b_en: From 2026-10-17, cosmetics require mandatory BPJPH halal certification; unapproved items must bear a red 'NON HALAL' mark. Must also comply with local CPKB/GMP standards.

faqs.q_zh: 测试报告有效期是多久？
faqs.a_zh: SPF/PA 测试结果需对应最终配方及标签。一旦更改滤光剂或成膜剂，即视为新配方，需重新送测，原报告失效。
faqs.q_en: How long is the test report valid?
faqs.a_en: Reports are tied to the final formula. Any change to filters or film formers is a new formula, requiring new tests.

faqs.q_zh: 防晒喷雾能做吗？
faqs.a_zh: 气雾剂形态在印尼受严格管控，需通过吸入暴露及运输限制评估，且需确认当地药监对气雾罐的准用情况。
faqs.q_en: Can we use a spray format?
faqs.a_en: Aerosols are strictly regulated; they must pass inhalation exposure and transport limits, and local BPOM approval is required.

sources.t: 各国法规 · 印度尼西亚

ae-skincare-oem.q_zh: 在阿联酋上市一款护肤产品(精华 / 面霜),代工厂要准备哪些资料、备案多久能拿到编号?
ae-skincare-oem.q_en: Launching a skincare product (serum or cream) in the UAE: what does the OEM factory need to prepare, and how long does notification take?
ae-skincare-oem.lead_zh: 在阿联酋销售面霜或精华，代工厂需协助品牌方完成双轨制前置程序，资料要求包括阿拉伯语标签、INCI 成分表及 GSO 1943 合规证明。 依据 2014 年第 18 号内阁决议，备案分两步：先由阿联酋法人主体获取 MoIAT ECAS 证书（效期一年），再在迪拜市政厅 Montaji 系统完成产品注册（效期五年）。 法定责任主体必须是阿联酋当地法人，具体备案周期依审核负荷定，以书面报价为准。
ae-skincare-oem.lead_en: To launch in the UAE, an OEM must prepare Arabic labels and INCI declarations for the dual-track pre-market system. Under Cabinet Decision 18/2014, a local UAE legal entity must secure a MoIAT ECAS Certificate of Conformity (valid 1 year), followed by product registration on the Dubai Municipality's Montaji system (valid 5 years). Only local entities hold these rights.

sections.b_zh: 品牌方无法直接申请注册，必须委托阿联酋境内注册的进口商或分销商作为持证方，负责对接主管机构与承担法定追责。
sections.b_en: Brands cannot hold registrations; a UAE-incorporated distributor or importer must act as the legal licensee for all regulatory filings and accountability.

sections.b_zh: 需提交 阿语/英语双语文签、完整 INCI 配方、批次信息与有效期、过敏原及警示声明，并确认符合 GSO 1943 限制物质要求，标签中禁止出现猪肉成分。
sections.b_en: Requires bilingual Arabic/English labels, full INCI list, batch/expiry data, and allergen warnings. Content must comply with GSO 1943 restrictions, strictly excluding pork-derived ingredients.

sections.b_zh: 流程分两步：首先通过 MoIAT 取得 ECAS 证书用于清关，随后在迪拜市政厅 Montaji 系统完成 5 年期的产品注册，两步均通过后方可进行零售销售。
sections.b_en: Process involves obtaining a MoIAT ECAS certificate for customs, followed by a 5-year Montaji product registration for retail clearance; both must be complete before sale.

faqs.q_zh: 出口国已备案或完成 FDA 设施注册能否免审？（注册≠批准、不发证书）
faqs.a_zh: 不能。中国备案或美国设施注册回执都不是证书，在阿联酋系统中无互认效力（注册≠批准、不发证书），仍须按当地法规完成全流程审查。
faqs.q_en: Do other jurisdictions' filings exempt UAE review?
faqs.a_en: No. Chinese or FDA filings are not mutually recognized; full UAE local regulatory procedures apply.

faqs.q_zh: 若宣称具有保湿或抗氧化功效，资料要求是否增加？
faqs.a_zh: 基础资料不变，但需提供相应检测或评估报告支撑宣称，避免因违规宣传导致清关受阻或产品下架。
faqs.q_en: Does claiming moisturizing properties increase document requirements?
faqs.a_en: Supporting reports are required for efficacy claims to prevent customs holds or post-market penalties.

sources.t: 各国法规 · 阿拉伯联合酋长国

ph-cleansing-oem.q_zh: 在菲律宾做氨基酸洁面代工,表活体系怎么选、备案与标签要注意什么?
ph-cleansing-oem.q_en: Amino-acid cleanser OEM for the Philippines: how is the surfactant system chosen, and what must be right for notification and labeling?
ph-cleansing-oem.lead_zh: 菲律宾氨基酸洁面以弱酸 pH 与氨基酸/APG/两性复配定体系,备案走 FDA Philippines 的 pre-market notification,标签按 ACD 附录 I 要求英/菲语信息。 表活选型须匹配剂型、泡沫与肤感目标,法规与标签文字以最新官方文本为准。
ph-cleansing-oem.lead_en: For the Philippines, an amino-acid cleanser should use a weakly acidic pH with amino-acid, APG, and amphoteric surfactants, paired with an FDA Philippines pre-market notification and ACD Appendix I labeling in English or Filipino. Surfactant selection must match texture, foam, and after-feel targets; regulatory and label text follow the latest official versions.

sections.b_zh: 先定剂型、泡沫方式与洗后肤感:氨基酸主体系偏温和,APG 需管理 pH 与气味,加盐增稠不稳;敏感肌下调活性物总浓度。
sections.h_en: How to set the surfactant system
sections.b_en: Define format, foam method, and after-feel first: amino-acid systems are milder; manage APG pH and odor; avoid salt thickening; lower total actives for sensitive skin.

sections.b_zh: 氨基酸体系控在弱酸到中性偏酸;做低温循环与高温加速,冲洗类必做 ISO 11930/USP <51> 防腐挑战。
sections.b_en: Keep pH weakly acidic to neutral; run cold-cycling and 40°C accelerated tests; preservative challenge per ISO 11930 / USP <51> is mandatory for rinse-off.

sections.b_zh: 由持 LTO 的菲律宾责任方在 FDA eServices 提交 notification;标签含成分、产地、LTO 方信息、批号与有效期,以最新官方文本为准。
sections.b_en: A Philippine LTO holder files the notification via FDA eServices; labels must include ingredients, country of manufacture, LTO details, batch, and expiry, per the latest official text.

faqs.q_zh: 能照竞品成分表复刻配方吗?
faqs.a_zh: 不能承诺同效,只做肤感与性能对标,成分表缺比例与牌号。
faqs.q_en: Can I replicate a competitor by ingredient list?
faqs.a_en: No guaranteed same performance; benchmark sensory and functional targets only; lists lack ratios and raw-material grades.

faqs.q_zh: 泡沫少该加表活吗?
faqs.a_zh: 不应靠堆浓度解决,需调整复配与起泡方式,否则刺激与成本上升。
faqs.q_en: Should I raise surfactant total for more foam?
faqs.a_en: Do not increase total actives; adjust co-surfactants and lathering method to avoid irritation and cost.

vn-skincare-oem.q_zh: 在越南上市一款护肤产品(精华 / 面霜),代工厂要准备哪些资料、备案多久能拿到编号?
vn-skincare-oem.q_en: Launching a skincare product (serum or cream) in Vietnam: what does the OEM factory need to prepare, and how long does notification take?
vn-skincare-oem.lead_zh: 结论：在越南上市属于 Pre-market product notification，须提交资料给 Drug Administration of Vietnam (DAV) 以获得编号（valid 5 years）。 代工厂负责提供产品配方、INCI 清单、GMP 证明（如 ISO 22716）及安全评估。 注册周期以书面报价为准，建议按 6-12 个月排期。
vn-skincare-oem.lead_en: Launching in Vietnam requires Pre-market product notification to DAV. The OEM must provide INCI formulas, GMP certificates (ISO 22716), and safety assessment documents. A notification number valid for 5 years is issued upon review.

sections.h_zh: 代工厂需准备的核心技术文件
sections.b_zh: 产品配方与 INCI 清单、GMP/ISO 22716 证明、原料安全数据、稳定性测试报告及标签草稿。越南法规要求提供完整成分信息以进行合规预审。
sections.b_en: Full INCI list, GMP/ISO 22716 certificate, raw material safety data, stability test reports, and label drafts are required for pre-compliance review.

sections.h_zh: 法定责任人与越南实体要求
sections.b_zh: 须由越南当地实体或进口商作为责任人持有备案编号，外资代工厂不能直接持证。若客户在越南无实体，须先指定当地授权代理或寻找持证进口商。
sections.b_en: A Vietnam-based entity or importer must hold the notification receipt. Foreign manufacturers cannot directly hold licenses; local agents are required.

sections.h_zh: 备案周期与编号有效期
sections.b_zh: 取得 DAV 备案号后有效期为 5 年。审核周期以书面报价为准，受最新法规 Circular 34/2025/TT-BYT 在线申报要求影响，需预留充分缓冲。
sections.b_en: The DAV notification number is valid for 5 years. The review period depends on the written quote and current online declaration requirements.

faqs.q_zh: 备案期间能否先进行小批量清关试销？
faqs.a_zh: 不能，必须持有 DAV 有效备案号后方可合法流通上市。
faqs.q_en: Can small-batch customs clear for trial sales before notification?
faqs.a_en: No, the valid DAV notification number is required before any legal distribution or sales.

faqs.q_zh: 清真认证在越南是否有强制要求？
faqs.a_zh: 目前非强制，但建议主动申请以增加当地市场接受度。
faqs.q_en: Is Halal certification mandatory in Vietnam?
faqs.a_en: Not mandatory currently, but voluntary certification is recommended to improve market acceptance.

vn-body-care-oem.q_zh: 在越南做身体乳 / 沐浴露代工,香精过敏原与标签怎么处理?
vn-body-care-oem.q_en: Body lotion and body wash OEM for Vietnam: how are fragrance allergens and labeling handled?
vn-body-care-oem.lead_zh: 结论：越南市场不豁免香精致敏物标注，须按 INCI 将 26 种过敏原逐项单列；标签必须包含越南语成分表、净含量及有效期，由越南境内主体负责申报。 参考化妆品法规以最新官方文本为准。
vn-body-care-oem.lead_en: Conclusion: Vietnam does not exempt fragrance allergen labeling; all 26 designated allergens must be listed separately under INCI. Labels must be in Vietnamese, showing net content, batch, and expiry. A Vietnam-based entity is required to manage the pre-market product notification, following the latest legal text.

sections.b_zh: 含香水或精油的产品须识别 26 种致敏香料。驻留类（身体乳）与淋洗类（沐浴露）阈值不同。供应商须提供过敏原申报表与 IFRA 合规文件，作为官方备案依据。
sections.b_en: Products with fragrance must declare specific allergens. Resinuous (body lotion) and rinse-off (body wash) thresholds vary. Suppliers must provide allergen reports and IFRA compliance data.

sections.b_zh: Labels must be in Vietnamese, detailing ingredients, net content, batch, and expiry. Foreign OEMs require a Vietnamese importer or agent for legal notification.
sections.b_en: Labels must be in Vietnamese, detailing ingredients, net content, batch, and expiry. Foreign OEMs require a Vietnamese importer or agent for legal notification.

sections.b_zh: 越南上市前须向主管部门申报（công bố sản phẩm mỹ phẩm）。责任人必须为越南境内实体，凭回执开展市场销售。
sections.b_en: Pre-market notification (công bố sản phẩm mỹ phẩm) is required. The responsible party must be a Vietnam-established entity to obtain a valid receipt number.

faqs.q_zh: 香精过敏原检测数据如何获取？
faqs.a_zh: 由香精供应商提供 0.0001% 级过敏原申报表及 IFRA 合规声明，不得由代工厂自行猜测。
faqs.q_en: How to obtain allergen test data?
faqs.a_en: Supplied by the fragrance supplier as a formal declaration; OEMs do not estimate values.

faqs.q_zh: 标签是否支持多语言印刷？
faqs.a_zh: 进口产品允许辅助使用其他语言，但必须以越南语为主标签，且须包含所有法定字段。
faqs.q_en: Can labels be multilingual?
faqs.a_en: Supplementary labels are allowed on imports, but Vietnamese must remain the primary legal text.

th-sun-care-oem.q_zh: 在泰国卖防晒产品,SPF / PA 检测报告要哪一种、备案怎么走?
th-sun-care-oem.q_en: Selling sunscreen in Thailand: which SPF / PA test report is accepted, and how is the product notified?
th-sun-care-oem.lead_zh: 泰国对防晒产品的SPF与PA/UVA数值均要求提供符合国际标准化组织方法的体外或人体测试报告，并由泰国注册制造商或进口商通过Thai FDA电子系统提交Pre‑market notification（จดแจ้ง）。 测试报告需采用ISO 24444（SPF人体测试）或等效方法，以及ISO 24443（UVA防护体外测试）或等效方法；备案责任方须持有泰国营业执照并在标签标注泰语备案编号。 具体测试方法目录与限量清单以泰国FDA最新发布为准。
th-sun-care-oem.lead_en: Thailand requires sunscreen products to submit SPF and UVA‑PA test reports following ISO 24444 (human SPF) or equivalent, and ISO 24443 (in vitro UVA protection) or equivalent. A Thai‑registered manufacturer or importer must file a Pre‑market notification (จดแจ้ง) electronically with the Thai FDA before manufacture or import. The notification receipt is valid for 3 years and must appear on the Thai‑language label. All requirements are subject to the latest official texts issued by the Thai Food and Drug Administration.

sections.b_zh: SPF数值须按人体试验方法（ISO 24444或等效国家标准）测试；UVA防护等级（PA）须按体外透射法（ISO 24443）或等效方法测试。实验室应具备ISO/IEC 17025资质，报告语言建议为英文或泰文。不得以体外预筛数据或模拟计算结果替代对人体测试的报告用于标签宣称。
sections.b_en: SPF values must be generated by human tests per ISO 24444 or an equivalent standard; PA/UVA rating requires in vitro transmittance testing per ISO 24443 or equivalent. Laboratories must hold ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation. Reports should be in English or Thai.体外 pre‑screening or simulated values cannot replace human‑test reports for label claims.

sections.b_zh: 上市前须通过Thai FDA电子系统提交Pre‑market notification（จดแจ้ง）。提交方必须是泰国境内注册的制造商或进口商，持有有效营业执照并具备化妆品备案责任资格。备案材料包括产品配方、生产工艺概要、标签样稿、测试报告等。 Notification receipt有效期3年，逾期需重新备案。
sections.b_en: A Pre‑market notification (จดแจ้ง) must be filed electronically with the Thai FDA before manufacture or import. The notifier must be a Thai‑registered manufacturer or importer with a valid business license. Required documents include formula, manufacturing process summary, label mock‑up, and test reports. The receipt is valid for 3 years.

sections.b_zh: 标签必须以泰语标注，且在进口后30日内加贴。内容包括：产品名称与类型、备案编号、全成分表（INCI）、泰国责任方名称与地址、批号、生产日期与限期使用日期、净含量及警示语。外语可同时出现。泰国目前执行东盟化妆品指令附录所列准用滤光剂清单，并正在修订禁用与限用物质（如Quaternium‑15、苯酮类等）。具体准用清单与限量以Thai FDA最新公告为准。
sections.b_en: The label must be in Thai and applied within 30 days of import. Required fields: product name & type, notification number, INCI ingredient list, Thai responsible party’s name & address, batch, manufacture/expiry dates, net content, and warnings. Foreign text may appear alongside. Thailand follows the ASEAN Cosmetic Directive annexes for UV filters; recent drafts propose adding banned/restricted substances. Exact lists are subject to the latest Thai FDA announcements.

faqs.q_zh: 泰国是否接受中国或欧盟的SPF测试报告？
faqs.a_zh: 泰国未明确承认其他国家的测试报告等效。若报告方法符合ISO 24444/ISO 24443且实验室具备ISO 17025资质，Thai FDA可接受，但最终以官方书面确认为准。
faqs.q_en: Does Thailand accept SPF test reports from China or the EU?
faqs.a_en: Thailand does not explicitly recognize reports from other countries. If the report follows ISO 24444/ISO 24443 and the lab is ISO 17025 accredited, it may be accepted, but final determination rests with Thai FDA.

faqs.q_zh: 防晒产品标签上的SPF/PA数值可以提前印刷吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不可。数值必须由正式测试报告支撑，备案完成前不得印于终包。若标签在测试完成前下印，将导致数值无法合规宣称，需重新印刷。
faqs.q_en: Can SPF/PA values be printed on labels before testing is completed?
faqs.a_en: No. Values must be supported by formal test reports. Labels cannot bear unverified claims before notification completion; premature printing risks non‑compliant labeling and reprint costs.

us-skincare-oem.q_zh: 在美国上市一款护肤产品(精华 / 面霜),代工厂要准备哪些资料、备案多久能拿到编号?
us-skincare-oem.q_en: Launching a skincare product (serum or cream) in the United States: what does the OEM factory need to prepare, and how long does notification take?
us-skincare-oem.lead_zh: 美国护肤产品在 FD&C Act 及 MoCRA 框架下无需上市前审批获取编号，但强制要求完成工厂场地注册与产品列名。 需准备的责任人信息、成分表与不良事件记录系统缺一不可。 完成 Cosmetics Direct 列名后即可合法售卖，合规周期取决于资料齐备度，无官方审批等待期。
us-skincare-oem.lead_en: US skincare products require no pre-market approval or ID number under the MoCRA framework. Factories must complete mandatory facility registration and product listing via FDA's Cosmetics Direct portal. Preparation of responsible person details, INCI labels, and adverse event tracking is essential. Once listed, the product is legally sellable; timelines depend on document readiness rather than an official regulatory review period.

sections.b_zh: 需准备产品全成分 INC 列表（降序排列）、美国责任人（名称与有效通讯方式）及 2024 年 7 月生效的安全声明文件。工厂需同步建立产品上市后的不良事件报告系统与记录保存机制。
sections.b_en: Requires complete INCI lists, a designated U.S. responsible person, and safety substantiation records. Facilities must maintain an adverse event reporting system and record-keeping protocol active as of July 2024.

sections.b_zh: 在 FDA Cosmetics Direct 系统提交场地注册与产品列名，官方无固定审批等待期。资料合规完整可立即通过，系统操作响应通常以小时计。工厂需预留时间应对 FDA 的资质核验或补件通知。
sections.b_en: FDA's Cosmetics Direct portal has no fixed review wait time. Submissions pass instantly upon document completion, though manufacturers should reserve time for potential FDA verification or additional information requests.

sections.b_zh: 标签需符合 21 CFR 701，明确成分、净含量及责任人。严禁在标签或电商页面把设施注册写成批准或证书（注册≠批准、不发证书）。上架亚马逊等北美平台时，平台会自动匹配合规要素，需确保文案与产品备案信息完全一致。
sections.b_en: Labels must comply with 21 CFR 701. Prohibited to claim approval or a certificate from facility registration on packaging or listings (registration is not approval, and no certificate is issued). Platforms like Amazon require listing data to exactly match regulatory filings to prevent delisting.

faqs.q_zh: MoCRA 对代工厂有豁免吗？
faqs.a_zh: 代工厂若不直接销售产品则不适用小规模豁免，但作为生产场地必须严格执行 FDA 场地注册要求。
faqs.q_en: Is there a MoCRA exemption for OEMs?
faqs.a_en: If not selling directly, OEMs don't qualify for the small business exemption but must complete mandatory facility registration.

faqs.q_zh: 成分需要 FDA 逐一审批吗？
faqs.a_zh: 普通化妆品成分无需 FDA 审批，但必须确保不在 FDA 禁用或限用清单中，并保留安全性自证数据。
faqs.q_en: Does FDA approve individual ingredients?
faqs.a_en: No. Ordinary cosmetic ingredients are not pre-cleared as a product approval; they must stay off prohibited lists and need safety substantiation. Registration is not approval, and no certificate is issued.

us-hair-care-oem.q_zh: 在美国做洗发水 / 护发素代工,无硫酸盐配方与标签要注意什么?
us-hair-care-oem.q_en: Shampoo and conditioner OEM for the United States: what matters in a sulfate-free formula and on the label?
us-hair-care-oem.lead_zh: 美国洗发水/护发素代工涉及「无硫酸盐」配方时，首先应以最新官方文本为准，明确区分「无硫酸盐」宣称与 MoCRA 标签法下成分列出的法定差异：MoCRA 下成分按 INCI 名降序排列，若使用 SLES/SLS 等硫酸盐类表活，标签必须如实列出；选用氨基酸或 APG 等替代体系时，体系 pH 控制在弱酸至中性偏酸，避免偏低时游离酸析出。 无硫酸盐体系在泡沫、冲洗感、卸除力方面表现不同，需结合泵头/起泡网等验收方式定标。
us-hair-care-oem.lead_en: For US sulfate-free shampoo and conditioner OEM, label compliance hinges on the MoCRA-era rules, which require ingredient declaration in descending INCI order. A true sulfate-free system must avoid SLES/SLS; if any sulfate remains, it must appear on the label. Formulation should target a weakly acidic to neutral-slightly-acid pH window to prevent acid precipitation. Foam, rinse-out feel, and cleansing power vary by surfactant stack, so acceptance method (pump, net, hand) must be fixed early. All numbers: see written quote.

sections.h_zh: 标签合规：MoCRA 成分列与无硫酸盐宣称
sections.b_zh: 美国洗发水/护发素标签按 FD&C Act Chapter VI 及 MoCRA 施行，英文标签含身份、净含量、成分（INCI 降序）、警示、责任人名称/地址。若配方含任何硫酸盐表活（SLES/SLS 等），必须在成分表如实列出；「无硫酸盐」宣称意味着主体系不得含硫酸盐类。MoCRA 还要求责任人地址或电话/邮箱用于不良反应联系。以最新官方文本为准。
sections.h_en: Labeling: MoCRA ingredient list and sulfate-free claims
sections.b_en: US haircare labels follow FD&C Act Ch. VI + MoCRA: English identity, net contents, INCI ingredients in descending order, warnings, responsible person name/address. Any sulfate surfactant (SLES/SLS, etc.) must be declared. A "sulfate-free" claim means the main system excludes sulfates. MoCRA adds a domestic address/phone/email for adverse-event contact. See latest official text.

sections.h_zh: 无硫酸盐表活选型与泡沫设计
sections.b_zh: 氨基酸表活单体起泡与稳泡弱于硫酸盐类，单独堆浓度会推高成本与刺激而不改善泡沫，需引入两性/非离子辅助表活，并接受洗后偏滑肤感。APG（烷基糖苷）偏碱且有特有气味，需 pH 调整与香型设计配合。泡沫验收方式（手搓、起泡网、泵头）不同，判定标准差异大，定泡沫标准前需确认使用方式。
sections.h_en: Surfactant selection and foam design for sulfate-free systems
sections.b_en: Amino-acid surfactants have weaker foaming than sulfates; stacking concentration raises cost and irritation without fixing foam—pair with amphoteric/nonionic co-surfactants, accepting a slightly slicker rinse feel. APG trends alkaline with a characteristic odor; plan pH and fragrance accordingly. Foam acceptance criteria differ by method (hand, net, pump), so confirm usage before setting standards.

sections.b_zh: 冲洗类水基产品微生物风险高于驻留类，防腐挑战测试不可省略；若走无防腐剂路线，通常改用多元醇/有机酸替代防腐体系，不等于零抗菌成分。低温结晶/浑浊是氨基酸体系常见风险，配方定稿前需完成低温循环与高温加速稳定性测试，避免冬季运输后整批不合格。帛卉质检体系含 36 项（IQC/IPQC/OQC），稳定性按 40°C 加速 3 个月执行。
sections.b_en: Rinse-off water-based products carry higher microbial risk than leave-on; challenge testing is mandatory. A "preservative-free" route usually means polyol/organic-acid alternatives, not zero antimicrobials. Low-temperature crystallization and haze are common amino-acid-system risks—confirm via low-temperature cycling and 40°C/3-month accelerated stability before finalizing. BIOSPHERE runs 36 QC checkpoints; stability per 40°C × 3 months.

faqs.q_zh: 「无硫酸盐」能否写成 0% SLS/SLES？
faqs.a_zh: 可以，前提是主体系不含任何硫酸盐类；若含其他硫酸盐衍生物，仍须在成分表列出，宣称与实际配方须一致。
faqs.q_en: Can we claim "0% SLS/SLES"?
faqs.a_en: Yes, if the main system excludes all sulfate-class surfactants. Any other sulfate derivatives must still be declared; claim must match the actual formula.

faqs.q_zh: 泵头出泡系统对泡沫有什么要求？
faqs.a_zh: 泵头空气比与孔径直接决定泡沫形态，包材未定就调泡沫等于白调；建议先固定包材再定表活比例与验收标准。
faqs.q_en: What foam specs does a pump head set?
faqs.a_en: Pump air ratio and orifice size determine foam structure. Fix packaging before tuning surfactant ratios and acceptance criteria.

ask-botanical-batch-stability.q_zh: 我想开发一款主打积雪草提取物的舒缓精华，但很担心不同批次的植物原料导致产品出现色差、褐变或气味不一致，同时希望宣称“无添加防腐”，请问工厂如何解决植物原料的批次稳定性以及安全实现无防腐体系？
ask-botanical-batch-stability.q_en: I am developing a soothing essence featuring Centella asiatica extract, but I'm worried about batch-to-batch color variance, browning, or odor inconsistency from botanical ingredients, while also claiming 'preservative-free.' How does the factory ensure botanical lot stability and safely formulate a preservative-free system?
ask-botanical-batch-stability.lead_zh: 结论：植物提取物批次一致性须以「产地-采收季-溶剂-特征指标区间」四要素锁定为前提；因提取物本身含糖与氨基酸，无防腐宣称在安全边界内落地必须配合水活度控制、真空或单剂量包材及完整的 ISO 11930 / USP <51> 挑战测试。
ask-botanical-batch-stability.lead_en: Lot consistency of botanical extracts must be anchored to four elements: origin, harvest season, solvent, and a defined active-index range. Because extracts contain sugars and amino acids, a 'preservative-free' claim requires strict water-activity control, vacuum or single-dose packaging, and full ISO 11930 / USP <51> challenge testing to ensure safety.

sections.b_zh: 需与供应商约定积雪草提取物的固定特征指标区间、部位、产地与采收季；任何一项变更即视为新原料，必须重新做相容性与稳定性验证，避免沿用旧批数据。
sections.b_en: Agree with suppliers on a fixed index range, plant part, origin, and harvest season for Centella extract. Any change treats it as a new raw material, requiring full compatibility and stability re-verification instead of reusing old batch data.

sections.b_zh: 针对褐变与气味漂移，建立「封样对照+描述性词条+判定人」机制；褐变多由多酚氧化与金属离子催化引起，优先在工艺中加螯合剂、控制顶空氧与避光包材，而非盲目增加抗氧化剂。
sections.b_en: For browning and odor drift, use a retained sample plus descriptive terms and a designated approver. Browning is often caused by polyphenol oxidation and metal catalysis, so prioritize chelators, headspace oxygen control, and opaque packaging over simply adding more antioxidants.

sections.h_zh: 无防腐体系的安全设计
sections.b_zh: 植物提取物易致微生物超标，实施「无防腐」宣称须严格控制水活度，选用真空泵或单剂量次抛包材，并执行全项防腐挑战测试（以最新官方文本为准），绝不能直接添加传统防腐剂替代。
sections.b_en: Extracts feed microbes. A 'preservative-free' claim requires strict water-activity control, vacuum or single-dose packaging, and comprehensive preservative-efficacy testing (per latest official guidelines). Do not simply replace traditional preservatives without these structural safeguards.

faqs.q_zh: 工厂能否确保每批积雪草提取物的外观与气味绝对一致？
faqs.a_zh: 植物是农产品，批次存在天然波动。通过锁定产地、采收季、溶剂并设定允收区间可大幅降低风险，但无法做到绝对一致。
faqs.q_en: Can the factory guarantee absolute consistency in appearance and odor for every batch of Centella extract?
faqs.a_en: No. Botanicals are agricultural products with natural variability. Locking origin, harvest, solvent, and setting acceptance ranges significantly reduces risk, but absolute consistency is impossible.

faqs.q_zh: 如果「无防腐剂」挑战测试失败，还能在标签上写该宣称吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。测试未通过意味着产品无法保障货架期安全，任何市场均不允许以此误导消费者，须回归传统防腐体系。
faqs.q_en: If the 'preservative-free' challenge test fails, can the label still carry that claim?
faqs.a_en: No. Failing the test means shelf-life safety is compromised. No market allows misleading claims; the formula must return to a traditional preservative system.

ask-nude-lip-glaze-performance.q_zh: 我们要开发一系列裸色系的唇釉，必须确保在深肤色和浅肤色上都能显色且不暗沉，同时要求不沾杯和高持妆度，代工厂如何从色浆配方和膜感设计入手来平衡这两个看似冲突的需求？
ask-nude-lip-glaze-performance.q_en: We are developing a nude-tone lip glaze collection that must show pigment and remain non-dulling on both deep and light skin tones, while also offering excellent non-transfer and longevity. How can the factory balance these conflicting needs through pigment formulation and film-forming design?
ask-nude-lip-glaze-performance.lead_zh: 需先锁定深/浅肤色的测试标准及不沾杯验收动作，再据此重构配方。 裸色系唇釉实现“不暗沉”需控制铁黑（CI 77499）在基色浆中的用量，并优化光散射；同时采用“挥发性溶剂+成膜剂”体系以兼顾高显色与高持妆。 代工厂将通过两轮打样（定色相方向与封样）及 36 项质检，确保色浆分散稳定与膜感符合需求，相关法规合规性需结合目标市场最终确认。
ask-nude-lip-glaze-performance.lead_en: The formulation must be structured around a volatile-solvent film-former system to achieve high pigment load without transfer. For nude tones, balancing the light and dark skin tone performance requires precise control of pigment distribution and minimal Iron Black usage.

sections.b_zh: 通过优化颜料粒径分布与分散体系，避免色浆返粗导致裸色失透或变暗。深肤色显色需提升光散射效率，浅肤色侧重避免暗沉。
sections.b_en: Optimize particle size and dispersion systems to prevent pigment coarse-backing. Deep tones require higher light scattering; light tones avoid dullness.

sections.b_zh: 采用成膜剂替代单纯增加色料量，通过膜层提升不沾杯性能。膜感设计需防止拔干，平衡挥发速度与膜柔韧度。
sections.b_en: Use film-formers instead of excessive pigment. Film layering improves non-transfer. Design balances volatility and film flexibility.

sections.h_zh: 批次稳定性与合规控制
sections.b_zh: 建立 3-5 支母色浆体系管理批次色差，执行 ISO 22716 生产规范，确保裸色系在不同市场（如欧盟）的着色剂合规性。
sections.b_en: Manage batch variance with master colorants and ISO 22716 standards to ensure colorant compliance for nude tones across global markets.

faqs.q_zh: 不沾杯测试以何种标准验收？
faqs.a_zh: 需明确定义不沾杯测试动作（如喝水、口罩摩擦或 8 小时持妆），代工厂将以书面报价为准提供对应方案。
faqs.q_en: How is the non-transfer test defined?
faqs.a_en: The test action (e.g., drinking or mask friction) must be defined; the factory provides a written quote for the specific protocol.

faqs.q_zh: 如何解决裸色在深肤色上的暗沉感？
faqs.a_zh: 通过调整色浆中二氧化钛的用量与铁黑限制，优化光线反射。此调整需在对色环境中进行两轮验证，以确保视觉一致性。
faqs.q_en: How is dullness on deep skin tones resolved?
faqs.a_en: Tune Titanium Dioxide and Iron Black usage to optimize light reflection. Verification is done in two rounds in the designated color environment.

ask-ecommerce-packing-strategy.q_zh: 如果主要销售渠道是 TikTok Shop 和 亚马逊 FBA，对于小样、旅行装以及大容量的规格选择有什么特定建议？如何避免因为包装规格不符合平台要求或物流限制导致补单困难或退货率升高？
ask-ecommerce-packing-strategy.q_en: If our primary sales channels are TikTok Shop and Amazon FBA, what specific advice do you have regarding size variations like samples, travel sizes, and large bulk formats? How can we avoid restocking difficulties or high return rates caused by packaging specs that violate platform requirements or logistics limits?
ask-ecommerce-packing-strategy.lead_zh: 建议同一核心配方在 TikTok Shop 与 Amazon FBA 采用不同规格与包装，避免同规格同价导致比价与自我蚕食。 TikTok 端应准备 5–15 ml 的小样/旅行装规格用于达人合作，并确保质地具备视觉表现力；FBA 端大容量或主售规格必须先通过跌落、泄漏与堆码测试，标配内塞或封口膜以应对仓储高温与多次搬运。 目标若为大促或爆单，建议先备半成品再灌装，以缩短从 bulk 到成品的响应周期，降低断货风险。
ask-ecommerce-packing-strategy.lead_en: For the same core formula, use different sizes and packaging for TikTok Shop and Amazon FBA to prevent cross-platform price comparison. TikTok should carry 5–15 ml samples/travel sizes for creators and prioritize visually engaging textures. FBA SKUs require drop, leak, and stacking tests, plus inner seals or film to withstand high-temperature storage and repeated handling. For peak demand, pre-build bulk materials before filling to shorten turnaround and minimize stockouts.

sections.h_zh: TikTok 端规格与质地策略
sections.b_zh: TikTok 转化依赖前 3 秒视觉证据，应设计镜头上成立的质地（如拉丝、变色、起泡），并同步备 5–15 ml 小样/旅行装规格供达人使用。大容量规格在该渠道优先级低于展示效果好的中小规格，避免运输包装过重影响开箱体验。
sections.b_en: TikTok conversions rely on visual proof in the first 3 seconds. Design textures that look compelling on camera (pulling, color-shifting, foaming) and stock 5–15 ml samples for creators. Prioritize small-to-mid sizes over large bulk formats to avoid heavy packaging and poor unboxing.

sections.h_zh: FBA 端包装合规与物理测试
sections.b_zh: 走 Amazon FBA 的规格必须完成跌落、泄漏与堆码测试，内塞或封口膜列为标配。FBA 链路包裹被多次搬运且仓储温度可超 40℃，一次泄漏批次将导致差评长期压低 listing 转化，补救成本远高于包材升级。
sections.b_en: FBA specs must pass drop, leak, and stacking tests with inner seals or film as standard. Parcels are handled repeatedly and stored above 40°C; a single leak batch causes lasting negative reviews that hurt conversion, and remediation costs exceed packaging upgrades.

sections.h_zh: 双平台铺货与补单节奏
sections.b_zh: 若同时铺 TikTok 与 FBA，建议同配方不同规格与包材，避免同规格同价。预期爆单时先备半成品而非成品，bulk 到成品只需灌装与包装，比完整生产周期短，能降低断货对排名与广告投入的损失。
sections.b_en: When stocking both TikTok and FBA, use the same formula with different sizes and packaging to avoid self-cannibalization. For anticipated spikes, pre-build bulk materials instead of finished goods; filling and packaging bulk is faster than full production, reducing stockout damage to ranking and ad spend.

faqs.q_zh: 旅行装是否需要按特殊类别申报？
faqs.a_zh: 旅行装一般按普通化妆品申报，但含防晒、美白等特殊宣称须单独走特殊品类路径，以最新官方文本为准。
faqs.q_en: Are travel sizes declared as special category?
faqs.a_en: Travel sizes are usually filed as regular cosmetics, but claims like sun protection or whitening must follow special-category rules; check the latest official text.

faqs.q_zh: FBA 和 TikTok 能否共用同一批包装？
faqs.a_zh: 不建议共用。FBA 需满足跌落与堆码要求，TikTok 需视觉展示效果；共用易导致一侧不合规或转化差。
faqs.q_en: Can FBA and TikTok share the same packaging batch?
faqs.a_en: Not recommended. FBA requires drop/stacking compliance; TikTok needs visual appeal. Sharing risks non-compliance or poor conversion on one side.

ask-clarifying-ampoule-stability.q_zh: 我的水光安瓶主打“无防腐、纯净系”，但灌装后出现轻微浑浊和香精析出，工厂能否优化体系稳定性并说明如何调整pH值与增稠剂比例来解决复配冲突？
ask-clarifying-ampoule-stability.q_en: My 'preservative-free' hydra-ampoule is experiencing slight turbidity and fragrance precipitation after filling. Can the factory optimize the system's stability and explain how to adjust the pH and thickener ratios to resolve the compatibility conflicts?
ask-clarifying-ampoule-stability.lead_zh: 结论：当前体系无法通过调整 pH 或增稠剂解决，必须改变防腐与增溶路线。 依据 ISO 11930 挑战测试与增溶原理，香精析出是因胶束容纳量不足，浑浊源于低温或稀释导致的溶解极限击穿。 在零防腐剂条件下，开口水剂微生物风险极高。 建议采用次抛包装或提高多元醇总量，并重新评估香精用量，否则无法保证货架期稳定性。
ask-clarifying-ampoule-stability.lead_en: Conclusion: The current system cannot be fixed by adjusting pH or thickeners; the preservation and solubilization routes must change. According to ISO 11930 and solubilization principles, fragrance precipitation indicates insufficient micelle capacity, while turbidity signals a breakthrough in solubility limits. Preservative-free open water-based products carry high microbial risks. It is recommended to use ampoules or increase total polyols, and reassess fragrance usage to ensure shelf-life stability.

sections.b_zh: 轻微浑浊与香精析出表明体系已越过溶解极限。增溶依赖胶束容纳量而非搅拌时间，若香精或油溶性活性物总量超出增溶剂承载能力，低温或稀释时会发生相分离。此时调整 pH 无法解决物理相容性问题。
sections.b_en: Slight turbidity and fragrance precipitation indicate the system has exceeded solubility limits. Solubilization relies on micelle capacity, not mixing time. If fragrance or oil-soluble actives exceed the solubilizer's capacity, phase separation occurs at low temperatures or upon dilution. Adjusting pH cannot resolve this physical incompatibility.

sections.h_zh: 无防腐体系的稳定性风险
sections.b_zh: 宣称“无防腐”的水相安瓶若使用开放式包装，在真实消费场景下微生物超标风险极高，属于召回级事故。依据法规要求，必须通过完整的微生物挑战测试。建议改用单剂量次抛包装，或增加多元醇总量作为替代防腐路径，以换取合规与稳定。
sections.b_en: Open-packaging water-based ampoules claiming 'preservative-free' face high microbial failure risks in real use, constituting recall-level incidents. Per regulations, complete microbial challenge tests are mandatory. It is recommended to switch to single-dose ampoules or increase total polyols as an alternative preservation path to ensure compliance and stability.

sections.b_zh: 解决复配冲突需重新评估活性物清单与香精基质。若坚持澄清，需增加增溶剂比例或降低香精用量；若接受微乳，可优化乳化剂结构。切勿通过大幅提高增稠剂比例掩盖浑浊，这会改变流变学并加剧不稳定。最终配方需依据加速稳定性测试数据确定。
sections.b_en: Resolving compatibility conflicts requires reassessing the active list and fragrance base. To maintain clarity, increase the solubilizer ratio or reduce fragrance usage; if microemulsions are accepted, optimize emulsifier structure. Do not mask turbidity by drastically increasing thickener ratios, as this alters rheology and worsens instability. Final formulas must be determined by accelerated stability test data.

faqs.q_zh: 能否仅通过提高 pH 值来解决香精析出？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。香精析出是溶解度问题，提高 pH 可能加剧某些活性物的不稳定，需重新计算增溶剂比例。
faqs.q_en: Can raising the pH value alone solve fragrance precipitation?
faqs.a_en: No. Fragrance precipitation is a solubility issue. Raising pH may worsen the instability of certain actives; the solubilizer ratio must be recalculated.

faqs.q_zh: 无防腐水剂是否可以不做微生物挑战测试？
faqs.a_zh: 不可以。依据 ISO 11930，所有宣称无防腐或防腐替代的体系必须通过完整挑战测试方可放行。
faqs.q_en: Is it okay to skip microbial challenge tests for preservative-free liquids?
faqs.a_en: No. Per ISO 11930, all systems claiming preservative-free or alternative preservation must pass full challenge tests before release.

ask-halal-fragrance-retention.q_zh: 沙特客户要求产品必须带清真（Halal）天然香氛且无酒精，但现有香型在热区运输后味道变淡，工厂能否推荐符合IFRA标准的合规香型，并解决挥发性差异导致的留香问题？
ask-halal-fragrance-retention.q_en: The Saudi client requires a Halal-certified natural fragrance without alcohol, but the current scent fades after transport in hot climates. Can the factory recommend IFRA-compliant fragrance options and resolve the retention issue caused by volatility differences?
ask-halal-fragrance-retention.lead_zh: 现有香型高温变淡是轻组分挥发与香精结构问题，需换用低挥发天然香基、无酒精载体，并按 IFRA 与沙特无猪肉衍生物要求出全项声明。 工厂可开发合规替香，解决留香需做实装加速试验，周期与成本以书面报价为准。
ask-halal-fragrance-retention.lead_en: Scent fading in heat indicates volatility mismatch. A low-volatility, alcohol-free Halal natural base is required, with full IFRA and SFDA compliance files. The factory can develop a compliant alternative, and retention testing will be included;

sections.b_zh: 改用无酒精天然香基，全项出 Halal 与 IFRA 合规声明，排除动物源定香剂，以最新官方文本为准。
sections.b_en: Alcohol-free natural base, full Halal & IFRA declarations, no animal-derived fixatives, subject to latest official texts.

sections.b_zh: 按 40℃ 加速试验做实装评估，调低轻组分比例，优化载体与香精结构，验收以实装失重与气味可辨性为准。
sections.b_en: 40°C real-package testing, lower light components, optimize vehicle and structure; acceptance based on weight loss and scent.

sections.b_zh: 按 SFDA GHAD 平台登记，标签强制阿拉伯文并含 INCI 清单，须无猪肉衍生物，Halal 认证非法定强制但客户要求需满足。
sections.b_en: SFDA GHAD listing, mandatory Arabic labels with INCI, no pork derivatives; Halal certification legally optional but required by client.

faqs.q_zh: 能否保留原香型结构？
faqs.a_zh: 原结构在高温下挥发过快，须换低挥发组分，香型描述保留但物质基础更换。
faqs.q_en: Can the original structure be kept?
faqs.a_en: No. High volatility requires replacing light components while maintaining the scent profile description.

faqs.q_zh: 开发周期多久？
faqs.a_zh: 出样通常 5–14 天，含实装加速试验，详细周期以书面报价为准。
faqs.q_en: What is the development timeline?
faqs.a_en: Sampling usually 5–14 days including real-package accelerated testing; detailed timeline per written quote.

ask-ftc-efficacy-substantiation.q_zh: 我们在美国亚马逊站推广含A醇的眼霜，文案中使用了“clinically proven”和“dramatically reduces wrinkles”，若被职业打假人投诉，工厂能否提供符合FTC标准的功效实证文件及应对策略？
ask-ftc-efficacy-substantiation.q_en: We are promoting a Retinol eye cream on Amazon US with the text 'clinically proven' and 'dramatically reduces wrinkles.' If complained about by professional complainers, can the factory provide efficacy substantiation files compliant with FTC standards and a response strategy?
ask-ftc-efficacy-substantiation.lead_zh: “clinically proven”与“dramatically reduces wrinkles”在美国构成需强证据支撑的化妆品功效宣称，工厂无法提供替代证明。 依据 FTC substantiation 标准及 FDA 对 cosmetics 的规则，证据必须匹配成品形式、实际用量、使用周期与目标人群。 职业打假人投诉将触发平台处置与民事索赔，工厂仅在技术资料被用于宣传时承担合同责任。
ask-ftc-efficacy-substantiation.lead_en: The phrases 'clinically proven' and 'dramatically reduces wrinkles' constitute high-risk cosmetic claims requiring strong substantiation under FTC standards. The factory cannot provide substitute evidence. According to FDA regulations, proof must match the final product form, dosage, cycle, and target group. Complaints from professional complainers trigger platform penalties and civil claims, with factory liability limited to contract terms if its technical data is used.

sections.b_zh: 依据 FTC substantiation 要求，必须有人体功效评价报告证明眼霜实际效果。原料商提供的体外数据或 PPT 无法支撑成品宣称。若无法提供匹配证据，需立即删除高风险文案，避免被认定为虚假宣传。
sections.b_en: FTC requires human efficacy data matching the final product. In-vitro raw material data is insufficient. Delete high-risk text if evidence is missing to avoid false advertising claims.

sections.b_zh: 工厂不直接对终端广告负责，但出具的技术资料若被原样使用，需承担合同项下责任。所有对外技术文件必须标注“不得直接用于终端宣传”并保留发送记录，以厘清责任归属。
sections.b_en: Factories are not liable for terminal ads but are contractually bound if technical data is used. All external files must state 'not for terminal use' with sending records retained.

sections.b_zh: 面对投诉，优先下架高风险文案以止损，同步准备证据链。若无证据，不赌不被查，直接删除。平台处置后，需书面记录客户决策过程，工厂不背书宣称合法性，仅提供合规建议。
sections.b_en: Prioritize removing high-risk text to stop losses. If no evidence exists, delete claims. Document client decisions; factories advise compliance but do not endorse claim legality.

faqs.q_zh: 原料商数据能直接用于美国站宣传吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。证据必须指向成品形式、实际用量与目标人群，体外数据不支持成品功效宣称。
faqs.q_en: Can raw material data be used for US claims?
faqs.a_en: No. Evidence must target the final product form and dosage; in-vitro data does not support finished product claims.

faqs.q_zh: 工厂需承担虚假宣传的罚款吗？
faqs.a_zh: 仅在合同范围内承担追偿责任，不直接承担行政处罚。建议客户书面决策并保留记录。
faqs.q_en: Does the factory bear fines for false claims?
faqs.a_en: Liability is limited to contractual reimbursement, not direct administrative penalties. Clients should document decisions in writing.

ask-preservative-free-cleansing.q_zh: 如果我想做主打「无添加」的清洁产品，但不想添加传统防腐剂，代工厂有哪些稳定的替代防腐体系推荐，如何证明它能通过挑战测试？
ask-preservative-free-cleansing.q_en: For a 'preservative-free' cleansing product, what stable alternative preservation systems do you recommend, and how will you prove they pass challenge tests?
ask-preservative-free-cleansing.lead_zh: 含水性清洁产品无法做到绝对无防腐，替代防腐体系核心在于降低水活度或选用多元醇及有机酸协同。 证明效力必须依赖 ISO 11930 标准的完整挑战测试，而非仅做出厂检验。 具体替代方案及测试报告需结合配方水相比例与目标市场法规确认。
ask-preservative-free-cleansing.lead_en: Aqueous cleansing products cannot be truly preservative-free. Alternative systems rely on lowering water activity using polyols or organic acids. Efficacy must be proven via full ISO 11930 challenge tests, not just release tests. Specific systems depend on formulation ratios and target market regulations.

sections.b_zh: 低防腐路线通常通过高比例多元醇（如甘油、己二醇）降低水活度，或选用辛酰羟肟酸、多元醇复配物等抑菌助剂。这些手段不改变配方清洁主效能，但能显著抑制微生物繁殖。需根据产品 pH 值与基质营养度调整浓度。
sections.b_en: Low-preservation routes use high ratios of polyols to lower water activity or utilize synergistic antimicrobials like hexanediol. These maintain cleaning efficacy while inhibiting microbial growth. Concentrations must adjust to pH and nutrient load.

sections.b_zh: 验证防腐效力必须执行 ISO 11930 全程序测试，涵盖细菌、酵母及霉菌多种菌株。测试需模拟使用周期污染场景，而非仅做出厂微生物限度。报告需明确方法学与判定标准，作为货架期安全性的核心证据。
sections.b_en: Validation requires full ISO 11930 challenge tests covering bacteria, yeast, and mold strains. Tests simulate real-world usage contamination, not just release limits. Reports must specify methods and criteria as core evidence for shelf stability.

sections.b_zh: 宣称“无添加”需避免绝对化表述，防止被认定为欺诈。若目标市场包含欧盟或美国，须核对当地防腐剂使用清单。若配方含植物提取物等高营养基质，防腐强度需上调。出现 pH 漂移或粘度下降时，应优先排查微生物代谢风险。
sections.b_en: Avoid absolute claims to prevent fraud allegations. For EU or US markets, verify local preservative lists. If high-nutrient botanicals are included, increase preservation strength. Prioritize investigating microbial metabolism if pH drifts or viscosity drops.

faqs.q_zh: 不出厂检验能做货架期吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。出厂检验仅证生产时干净，挑战测试才证明使用期抵抗力。
faqs.q_en: Can shelf life be proven without release tests?
faqs.a_en: No. Release tests prove production cleanliness; challenge tests prove resistance during use.

faqs.q_zh: 多元醇体系算无添加吗？
faqs.a_zh: 需看成分定义。若多元醇在法规中归类为防腐剂，则需如实标注，不可宣称绝对无添加。
faqs.q_en: Does polyol system count as no-additives?
faqs.a_en: Depends on definitions. If classified as preservatives by regulations, they must be listed; avoid absolute no-additives claims.

ask-vc-aluminum-compatibility.q_zh: 我们这款高浓度的VC精华液换装到铝管后出现了变色，代工厂能帮忙做哪些相容性测试来排查是包材问题还是配方问题？
ask-vc-aluminum-compatibility.q_en: Our high-concentration VC serum changed color in aluminum tubes. What compatibility tests can the factory run to determine if it's packaging or formulation?
ask-vc-aluminum-compatibility.lead_zh: 变色归因首选惰性玻璃对照试验以区分铝包材腐蚀与VC自身氧化；铝管需同步评估涂层完整性及pH值。 检测项目包含失重率、色差ΔE及金属离子迁移量，需结合常温对照组确认长期稳定性。
ask-vc-aluminum-compatibility.lead_en: Attribution of color change in aluminum tubes requires a glass control test to distinguish package corrosion from Vitamin C auto-oxidation. Assess pH and coating integrity. Testing includes mass loss, color difference, and metal ion migration, verified with room-temperature controls.

sections.b_zh: 采用同配方的中性玻璃瓶作为惰性对照组。评估铝管涂层完整性，确认pH值是否低于4或高于8，排除铝材腐蚀产气与渗透风险。
sections.b_en: Use a glass vial as an inert control. Evaluate aluminum coating integrity and pH levels to rule out corrosion, gas generation, and coating failure.

sections.b_zh: 测定水含量、失重率及金属离子（铝、铁）迁移量。若含强还原剂，优先评估全塑泵芯，避免金属弹簧直接接触料体导致变色。
sections.b_en: Measure mass loss and metal ion migration (Al, Fe). For strong reducing agents, prioritize all-plastic pump systems to prevent metal contact.

sections.b_zh: 40℃加速3个月仅作风险筛查，必须保留常温同步样。若包装色母或材质改变，不得沿用旧报告，需重新执行全套相容性试验。
sections.b_en: 3-month accelerated testing (40°C) is for risk screening only; room-temperature samples are mandatory. Re-testing is required for packaging or colorant changes.

faqs.q_zh: 包材变更需要重新做试验吗？
faqs.a_zh: 需要。改变包材颜色、色母或材质均属于不同接触物，需重新评估。
faqs.q_en: Is re-testing required for packaging changes?
faqs.a_en: Yes. Changes in colorants or packaging materials require new compatibility evaluations.

faqs.q_zh: 能否只提供加速试验数据？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。仅凭加速数据无法得出长期稳定结论，必须包含常温对照组数据。
faqs.q_en: Can only accelerated data be provided?
faqs.a_en: No. Accelerated data alone cannot confirm long-term stability; room-temperature controls are required.

ask-tiktok-stockout-alignment.q_zh: 在 TikTok Shop 上架新品，怎么匹配工厂的补货节奏以避免因物流延迟导致的断货和差评？
ask-tiktok-stockout-alignment.q_en: How can we align our factory replenishment schedule with TikTok Shop trends to prevent stockouts and negative reviews caused by logistics delays?
ask-tiktok-stockout-alignment.lead_zh: 结论：建立基于TikTok Shop真实转化与物流前置期的动态补货模型，以书面报价为准。 工厂端需锁定FBA或平台仓的入仓规格，并预留3个月40℃加速稳定性观察期。 避免依赖短视频爆量，以数据驱动排产。
ask-tiktok-stockout-alignment.lead_en: The factory must lock in inbound specs for platform warehouses and reserve a 3-month 40℃ accelerated stability observation period. Avoid reliance on viral spikes; use data to drive production.

sections.b_zh: 按平台仓分拣与退货二次上架要求，定死外箱尺寸、单件重量与条码位置。帛卉在打样阶段需完成运输测试，防止漏液与掉标导致的差评。
sections.b_en: Finalize outer box dimensions, unit weight, and barcode placement per platform warehouse sorting and resale standards. BIOSPHERE must complete transport testing at the prototyping stage to prevent negative reviews from leakage or label loss.

sections.b_zh: 以已售链接的真实日销与物流延迟天数倒推补货量。帛卉按主推变体单独排产，次变体合并生产，避免按平均备货导致慢款压仓或快款断货。
sections.b_en: Reverse-calculate replenishment volume from real daily sales and logistics delay days. BIOSPHERE should produce main variants separately and batch secondary variants to avoid overstocking slow items or running out of fast ones.

sections.b_zh: 上架前完成40℃加速3个月稳定性观察及36项质检。帛卉需确认目标站点责任人及标签语言符合法规要求，以最新官方文本为准，防止链接暂停。
sections.b_en: Complete 3-month accelerated stability at 40℃ and 36-item quality checks before launch. BIOSPHERE must verify responsible person and label language meet regulatory standards, per latest official text, to prevent listing suspension.

faqs.q_zh: 工厂如何配合TikTok爆单后的补货？
faqs.a_zh: 以书面报价为准。需先提供真实转化数据证明，避免盲目扩产导致尾货积压。
faqs.q_en: How should the factory support replenishment after TikTok viral spikes?
faqs.a_en: Per written quotes. Require real conversion data first to avoid blind expansion and inventory accumulation.

faqs.q_zh: 断货后多久能恢复排名？
faqs.a_zh: 排名归零需重新积累，建议前置物流周期并预留安全库存。
faqs.q_en: How long to recover ranking after stockouts?
faqs.a_en: Ranking resets to zero, requiring re-accumulation. Recommend front-loading logistics cycles and maintaining safety stock.

my-cleansing-oem.q_zh: 在马来西亚做氨基酸洁面代工,表活体系怎么选、备案与标签要注意什么?
my-cleansing-oem.q_en: Amino-acid cleanser OEM for Malaysia: how is the surfactant system chosen, and what must be right for notification and labeling?
my-cleansing-oem.lead_zh: 马来西亚市场选用氨基酸与 APG 为主的弱酸体系：皂基/高浓度 SLES 会被敏感人群拒绝；氨基酸表活起泡弱，需加 10–15% 两性/非离子辅助并控制体系 pH 5. 5–6. 5，避免结晶与浑浊；目标人群若为敏感肌，总活性物下调并避开新表活/高香精。 备案：由 CNH 经 QUEST 3+ 在线通知；标签含马来语/英语、INCI、批号、厂址、CNH 信息；Halal 宣称须 JAKIM；法规变更（2026-07 NPRA Circular 2/2026）须核对，以最新官方文本为准。
my-cleansing-oem.lead_en: For Malaysia, anchor on a weakly acidic amino-acid + APG base. Sulfate‑ or soap‑base formulas face rejection by sensitive consumers. Amino surfactants foam weakly; add 10–15% amphoteric/non‑ionic helpers and hold pH 5. 5–6. 5 to avoid crystal or cloud formation. For sensitive‑skin targets, lower total actives and avoid novel surfactants/high fragrance. File via CNH on QUEST 3+. Labels in BM/EN must list INCI, CNH, batch and site. Halal claims require JAKIM. Check NPRA Circular No. 2/2026 (2026‑07) updates; rely on current official text.

sections.b_zh: 主表活：椰油酰基谷氨酸钠/肌氨酸钠 + APG 复配，pH 5.5–6.5；泡沫不足时加 10–15% 两性（甜菜碱）或葡糖苷，不靠堆总浓度；冬季结晶先调多元醇比例再谈增溶剂；敏感肌总活性物下调并避开新型表活与高浓度香精。
sections.b_en: Pair coco‑betaine or glutamate salt with APG, hold pH 5.5–6.5. For weak foam add 10–15% amphoteric or glucoside rather than raising total actives. Adjust polyols first for winter crystal risk; step down total actives and avoid novel surfactants or high fragrance for sensitive targets.

sections.b_zh: 须由马来西亚本地 CNH（SSM 注册）通过 QUEST 3+ 在线通知；通知有效期 2 年，提前至少 1 个月续；主管机构 NPRA，依据 Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984 及化妆品指南（以最新官方文本为准），核对 NPRA Circular No. 2/2026 附录修订。
sections.b_en: A Malaysian CNH (SSM‑registered) files via QUEST 3+. The notice is valid for two years and must be renewed one month before expiry. NPRA regulates under the 1984 Regulations and current guidelines (per latest official text); check the 2026 Circular No. 2/2026 annex updates.

sections.b_zh: 标签使用马来语或英语，含品名、功能、完整 INCI、生产国、CNH 名址、净含量、批号、制造与效期及必要警示；Halal 宣称必须取得 JAKIM 认证，否则不得标注；任何“零刺激/婴儿可用”等绝对化表述禁止使用。
sections.b_en: Labels in Bahasa Malaysia or English must show product name, function, full INCI, country of manufacture, CNH name/address, volume, batch, dates and warnings. A Halal claim requires JAKIM certification; absolute “zero irritation” or “baby‑safe” claims are prohibited.

faqs.q_zh: 能否直接照抄竞品 INCI 做配方？
faqs.a_zh: 不能逐条复刻；成分表缺比例与复配信息，仅做肤感与性能对标。
faqs.q_en: Can I copy a competitor's INCI line‑for‑line?
faqs.a_en: No. INCI lists lack ratios and blend data; match only the feel and performance benchmarks.

faqs.q_zh: 无硫酸盐/无皂基是否等于零风险？
faqs.a_zh: 不等于；无 SLS 仍需防腐挑战与低刺激验证，敏感人群仍可能反应。
faqs.q_en: Does “sulfate‑free/soap‑free” mean zero risk?
faqs.a_en: No. Sulfate‑free still requires preservative challenge and irritation testing; sensitive consumers may still react.

ae-hair-care-oem.q_zh: 在阿联酋做清真洗发水 / 护发素代工,配方要核哪些原料、清真认证和备案各要多久?
ae-hair-care-oem.q_en: Halal shampoo and conditioner OEM for the UAE: which ingredients are checked, and how long do halal certification and notification take?
ae-hair-care-oem.lead_zh: 在阿联酋代工洗护发产品，需确保配方不含动物源成分与乙醇，以符合自愿的 Halal 认证。 法规方面，UAE 实行 MoIAT ECAS 强制合规与 Dubai Montaji 注册双层上市路径，责任人须为 UAE 本地主体。 具体认证、合规及注册办理周期与费用均以书面报价为准，最终要求以最新官方文本为准。
ae-hair-care-oem.lead_en: For OEM shampoo and conditioner in the UAE, the formulation must be checked for animal-derived ingredients and alcohol to meet voluntary Halal standards. Regulation follows a two-tier system: a mandatory MoIAT ECAS certificate and Dubai Montaji registration, requiring a local UAE-based responsible entity. Certification, compliance, and registration timelines are subject to written quotes, with all requirements based on the latest official texts.

sections.b_zh: Halal 认证重点核查配方中所有动物源成分（如动物油脂、明胶、来源不明甘油）及含乙醇/变性乙醇的溶剂，需替换为植物或微生物发酵来源，并留存供应商来源声明。若配方含着色剂 CI 75470 等动物来源材料，需先行调整以防清真与素食双认证失效。
sections.b_en: Halal certification checks all animal-derived ingredients (e.g., animal fats, gelatin) and alcohol-based solvents, requiring substitution with plant or fermentation-sourced materials and retaining supplier declarations to prevent Halal and vegan certifications from being voided.

sections.h_zh: Halal 认证办理周期与要求
sections.b_zh: Halal 认证在 UAE 属于自愿性质，但在产品宣称中包含该词时必须取得。各认证机构对残留量、生产线隔离或共用产线的判定口径不一，周期取决于认证机构审核排期，通常以书面报价为准。帛卉已具备 HALAL 体系资质，可协助完成工厂级与产品级的审核对接。
sections.b_en: Halal certification in the UAE is voluntary but mandatory if claimed on labels. Timelines depend on the audit schedule of chosen agencies, which have varying standards for production lines. BIOSPHERE holds Halal framework qualifications and can assist with factory and product-level audits.

sections.h_zh: UAE 市场准入：ECAS 与 Montaji 流程
sections.b_zh: 按 Cabinet Decision 18/2014 与 GSO 1943 规定，上市前必须取得 MoIAT 颁发的 ECAS 证书（有效期1年）及 Dubai Municipality 的 Montaji 注册（有效期5年）。该流程必须由 UAE 境内法人实体（进口商或授权代理）作为责任人承担。办理周期受技术文档审核及主管机构排期影响，以书面报价为准。
sections.h_en: UAE Market Access: ECAS and Montaji Procedures
sections.b_en: Per Cabinet Decision 18/2014 and GSO 1943, a MoIAT ECAS certificate (1-year validity) and Dubai Montaji registration (5-year validity) are required. A UAE-incorporated entity must act as the responsible person. Timelines depend on technical documentation review and official schedules, based on written quotes.

faqs.q_zh: UAE 的法规对防腐剂与防晒剂有什么特别限制？
faqs.a_zh: 需符合 GSO 1943:2024 及 2024-05-04 更新的 MoIAT 技术指南，具体限值与禁用清单以最新官方文本为准。
faqs.q_en: What are the specific limits for preservatives and UV filters in UAE?
faqs.a_en: Must comply with GSO 1943:2024 and MoIAT Technical Guidelines updated May 2024; specific limits are subject to the latest official texts.

faqs.q_zh: 如果产品包装没有阿拉伯语标签会有什么后果？
faqs.a_zh: 清关将被拒绝。根据 UAE 标签规定，产品需包含阿拉伯语标识与 INCI 清单，否则无法合法销售。
faqs.q_en: What is the consequence of lacking an Arabic label?
faqs.a_en: Customs will reject it. UAE regulations mandate Arabic labeling and INCI lists for legal sale.

ph-body-care-oem.q_zh: 在菲律宾做身体乳 / 沐浴露代工,香精过敏原与标签怎么处理?
ph-body-care-oem.q_en: Body lotion and body wash OEM for the Philippines: how are fragrance allergens and labeling handled?
ph-body-care-oem.lead_zh: 销往菲律宾市场的身体乳与沐浴露，香精过敏原与标签管理需严格遵循FDA Philippines及东盟化妆品指令(ACD)。 香精成分需符合IFRA限用量及致敏香料清单要求，并按ACD附录I要求在标签上单列成分，提供合规的PIF。
ph-body-care-oem.lead_en: For OEM of body lotion and body wash in the Philippines, fragrance allergens and labeling must strictly comply with the FDA Philippines and the ASEAN Cosmetic Directive (ACD). Fragrance ingredients must meet IFRA limits and allergen lists, with mandatory itemized labeling under ACD Appendix I and the required Product Information File (PIF) submitted.

sections.h_zh: 菲律宾法规与标签标准
sections.b_zh: 依据 Republic Act No. 9711 及 DOH Administrative Order No. 2005-0025，需通过 FDA eServices 门户提交上市前通知(PIF)。标签须遵循 ACD 附录I，必须包含完整成分表、制造国、LTO持有人信息，并按指令规范使用英语或他加禄语。
sections.b_en: Under RA 9711 and DOH AO 2005-0025, products require pre-market notification via the FDA eServices portal with a Product Information File. Labels must strictly comply with ACD Appendix I, detailing full ingredient lists, country of manufacture, and LTO holder information in English or Filipino.

sections.b_zh: 香精供应商需正式提供IFRA合规声明及过敏原申报表。不论使用合成香精还是精油，均需按官方致敏香料清单逐项核算，不可将“天然”作为豁免理由。成分表出现Parfum的，禁止使用任何“无香精”表述。
sections.b_en: Fragrance suppliers must provide IFRA compliance statements and allergen declaration forms. Both synthetic and natural essences must be itemized per official sensitizing allergen lists, with 'natural' offering no exemptions. Products containing Parfum must never claim 'fragrance-free'.

sections.h_zh: 无香精宣称与脱味技术
sections.b_zh: 若需宣称“无添加香精”，须从原料端脱味起步，采用低味表活与低味防腐体系。凡使用遮味剂并在INCI标注Parfum的，从标签事实角度属于违规，必须重新设计配方以达成合规。
sections.b_en: For 'fragrance-free' claims, flavor masking must be eliminated by using low-odor surfactants and preservatives. Using masking agents and listing Parfum in INCI strictly violates labeling facts and requires reformulation to achieve compliance.

faqs.q_zh: 天然精油可以豁免单列过敏原吗？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。天然精油中的致敏成分总量通常更高，仍需依据IFRA限用量及官方清单逐项核算并申报。
faqs.q_en: Do natural essential oils exempt allergen labeling?
faqs.a_en: No. Natural essential oils have higher allergen totals and must be itemized under IFRA limits and official lists.

faqs.q_zh: 菲律宾市场允许宣称孕妇可用吗？
faqs.a_zh: 配方端不负责对宣称做临床评估，需结合当地法规与临床数据确认，避免绝对化表述。
faqs.q_en: Can 'safe for pregnant women' be claimed?
faqs.a_en: Formulators do not provide clinical conclusions; claims must be verified with local regulations to avoid absolute statements.

vn-hair-care-oem.q_zh: 在越南做洗发水 / 护发素代工,无硫酸盐配方与标签要注意什么?
vn-hair-care-oem.q_en: Shampoo and conditioner OEM for Vietnam: what matters in a sulfate-free formula and on the label?
vn-hair-care-oem.lead_zh: 在越南市场推行无硫酸盐洗发水和护发素，首先需确认体系能否匹配当地硬水条件。 若仅用烷基糖苷(APG)或氨基酸等单一表活，在含高硬度离子的水源中易导致起泡性能下降和皂垢析出。 合规方面，该类产品在上市前需由越南境内主体进行预上市产品备案。 标签必须依照最新法规用越南语规范列出成分、净含量及责任人，且若宣称“无硫酸盐”需通过防腐挑战测试与稳定性测试确认体系安全。
vn-hair-care-oem.lead_en: For sulfate-free hair care products in Vietnam, confirm that the surfactant system remains stable and foams properly under local hard-water conditions. Single surfactants like APG or amino acids may yield poor results if not blended correctly. Regulatory compliance requires pre-market notification filed by a Vietnam-registered entity before sale. All labels must be in Vietnamese, explicitly listing ingredients, net volume, and the responsible party. The 'sulfate-free' claim must be backed by validated microbial challenge and stability testing to ensure product safety.

sections.b_zh: 无硫酸盐配方常依赖 APG、氨基酸或甜菜碱复配。在打样与量产评估中，需先明确越南目标区域的水质。若在硬水环境下测试，皂基或单一阴离子系统容易起泡性能下降并产生难溶皂垢。
sections.b_en: Sulfate-free formulas typically rely on APG, amino acid, or betaine blends. During development, water hardness must be matched to the target Vietnamese region. High mineral content can drastically reduce foam and cause scaly deposit issues if the system is not balanced.

sections.h_zh: 法规备案与境内责任主体
sections.b_zh: 依据现行法规（以最新官方文本为准），进口洗发水需在越南卫生部的药品管理局(DAV)完成预上市备案，国内生产需向各省市卫生部备案。必须由在越南境内设有实体并持有备案回执的单位或进口商作为责任人。
sections.b_en: Per current regulations, imports of shampoos must be notified to Vietnam's DAV, while local products go to provincial health departments. The filing must be executed by a Vietnam-established entity acting as the responsible party and receiving a 5-year valid receipt.

sections.h_zh: 标签规范与防腐挑战测试
sections.b_zh: 越南语标签需包含产品名、功能、成分、净含量、批次与责任人信息。由于冲洗类产品微生物风险高于驻留类，即使执行“无防腐剂”路线，也需使用替代防腐体系进行 ISO 11930 / USP <51> 挑战测试。
sections.b_en: Vietnamese labels require detailed disclosures including active ingredients, batch, and responsible entity. Because rinse-off products face high microbial risks, 'preservative-free' routes require strict ISO 11930 / USP <51> challenge testing to confirm safety.

faqs.q_zh: 无硫酸盐洗发水能不能完全不带泡沫？
faqs.a_zh: 不能。无硫酸盐不等于低泡，但纯氨基酸或 APG 体系起泡绵密度弱于 SLES，通常需要复配辅助表活来平衡清洁力。
faqs.q_en: Does sulfate-free mean no foam?
faqs.a_en: Not exactly. Pure APG or amino acid systems foam less than SLES; co-surfactants are usually needed to balance clean feel and foam.

faqs.q_zh: 备案回执有效期是多长？
faqs.a_zh: 备案回执有效期通常为 5 年。5 年内若产品核心成分与配方未发生实质变更，无需重新备案。
faqs.q_en: How long is the notification valid?
faqs.a_en: The notification receipt is valid for 5 years. No re-notification is needed if the formula remains substantively unchanged.
